eta/fint.F:9:Clcs#include "kernnum/pilot.h"
eta/fint.F:10:          FUNCTION FINT(NARG,ARG,NENT,ENT,TABLE)
eta/fint.F:11:C
eta/fint.F:12:C   INTERPOLATION ROUTINE. AUTHOR C. LETERTRE.
eta/fint.F:13:C   MODIFIED BY B. SCHORR, 1.07.1982.
eta/fint.F:14:C
eta/fint.F:15:          INTEGER   NENT(9)
eta/fint.F:16:          REAL      ARG(9),   ENT(9),   TABLE(9)
eta/fint.F:17:          INTEGER   INDEX(32)
eta/fint.F:18:          REAL      WEIGHT(32)
eta/fint.F:19:          LOGICAL   MFLAG,    RFLAG
eta/fint.F:20:          FINT  =  0.
eta/fint.F:21:          IF(NARG .LT. 1  .OR.  NARG .GT. 5)  GOTO 300
eta/fint.F:22:          LMAX      =  0
eta/fint.F:23:          ISTEP     =  1
eta/fint.F:24:          KNOTS     =  1
eta/fint.F:25:          INDEX(1)  =  1
eta/fint.F:26:          WEIGHT(1) =  1.
eta/fint.F:27:          DO 100    N  =  1, NARG
eta/fint.F:28:             X     =  ARG(N)
eta/fint.F:29:             NDIM  =  NENT(N)
eta/fint.F:30:             LOCA  =  LMAX
eta/fint.F:31:             LMIN  =  LMAX + 1
eta/fint.F:32:             LMAX  =  LMAX + NDIM
eta/fint.F:33:             IF(NDIM .GT. 2)  GOTO 10
eta/fint.F:34:             IF(NDIM .EQ. 1)  GOTO 100
eta/fint.F:35:             H  =  X - ENT(LMIN)
eta/fint.F:36:             IF(H .EQ. 0.)  GOTO 90
eta/fint.F:37:             ISHIFT  =  ISTEP
eta/fint.F:38:             IF(X-ENT(LMIN+1) .EQ. 0.)  GOTO 21
eta/fint.F:39:             ISHIFT  =  0
eta/fint.F:40:             ETA     =  H / (ENT(LMIN+1) - ENT(LMIN))
eta/fint.F:41:             GOTO 30
eta/fint.F:42:  10         LOCB  =  LMAX + 1
eta/fint.F:43:  11         LOCC  =  (LOCA+LOCB) / 2
eta/fint.F:44:             IF(X-ENT(LOCC) .LT. 0) GOTO 12
eta/fint.F:45:             IF(X-ENT(LOCC) .EQ. 0) GOTO 20
eta/fint.F:46:             IF(X-ENT(LOCC) .GT. 0) GOTO 13
eta/fint.F:47:Clcs             IF(X-ENT(LOCC))  12, 20, 13
eta/fint.F:48:  12         LOCB  =  LOCC
eta/fint.F:49:             GOTO 14
eta/fint.F:50:  13         LOCA  =  LOCC
eta/fint.F:51:  14         IF(LOCB-LOCA .GT. 1)  GOTO 11
eta/fint.F:52:             LOCA    =  MIN0( MAX0(LOCA,LMIN), LMAX-1 )
eta/fint.F:53:             ISHIFT  =  (LOCA - LMIN) * ISTEP
eta/fint.F:54:             ETA     =  (X - ENT(LOCA)) / (ENT(LOCA+1) - ENT(LOCA))
eta/fint.F:55:             GOTO 30
eta/fint.F:56:  20         ISHIFT  =  (LOCC - LMIN) * ISTEP
eta/fint.F:57:  21         DO 22  K  =  1, KNOTS
eta/fint.F:58:                INDEX(K)  =  INDEX(K) + ISHIFT
eta/fint.F:59:  22            CONTINUE
eta/fint.F:60:             GOTO 90
eta/fint.F:61:  30         DO 31  K  =  1, KNOTS
eta/fint.F:62:                INDEX(K)         =  INDEX(K) + ISHIFT
eta/fint.F:63:                INDEX(K+KNOTS)   =  INDEX(K) + ISTEP
eta/fint.F:64:                WEIGHT(K+KNOTS)  =  WEIGHT(K) * ETA
eta/fint.F:65:                WEIGHT(K)        =  WEIGHT(K) - WEIGHT(K+KNOTS)
eta/fint.F:66:  31            CONTINUE
eta/fint.F:67:             KNOTS  =  2*KNOTS
eta/fint.F:68:  90         ISTEP  =  ISTEP * NDIM
eta/fint.F:69: 100         CONTINUE
eta/fint.F:70:          DO 200    K  =  1, KNOTS
eta/fint.F:71:             I  =  INDEX(K)
eta/fint.F:72:             FINT  =  FINT + WEIGHT(K) * TABLE(I)
eta/fint.F:73: 200         CONTINUE
eta/fint.F:74:          RETURN
eta/fint.F:75: 300      CONTINUE
eta/fint.F:76:Clcs         CALL KERMTR('E104.1',LGFILE,MFLAG,RFLAG)
eta/fint.F:77:Clcs          IF(MFLAG) THEN
eta/fint.F:78:Clcs             IF(LGFILE .EQ. 0) THEN
eta/fint.F:79:                WRITE(*,1000) NARG
eta/fint.F:80:Clcs             ELSE
eta/fint.F:81:Clcs                WRITE(LGFILE,1000) NARG
eta/fint.F:82:Clcs             ENDIF
eta/fint.F:83:Clcs          ENDIF
eta/fint.F:84:Clcs          IF(.NOT. RFLAG) CALL ABEND
eta/fint.F:85:          RETURN
eta/fint.F:86:1000      FORMAT( 7X, 24HFUNCTION FINT ... NARG =,I6,
eta/fint.F:87:     +              17H NOT WITHIN RANGE)

eta/README.md:1:# EXCLURAD
eta/README.md:2:
eta/README.md:3:Fortran code for calculation of QED radiative corrections to exclusive
eta/README.md:4:electroproduction on the nucleon. The current repository contains two
eta/README.md:5:configurations:
eta/README.md:6:
eta/README.md:7:- **Pion electroproduction** (original 2002 code): corrections to the
eta/README.md:8:  unpolarized coincidence cross section and beam spin asymmetry (fifth
eta/README.md:9:  structure function) for ep → e'nπ⁺.
eta/README.md:10:- **η-meson electroproduction** (2025 extension): adapted for ep → e'pη
eta/README.md:11:  using updated EtaMAID-2023 hadronic model tables and CLAS12 kinematics.
eta/README.md:12:
eta/README.md:13:Distinctive features of the underlying formalism:
eta/README.md:14:- Covariant infrared divergence cancellation (Bardin–Shumeiko method),
eta/README.md:15:  giving results independent of the soft/hard photon splitting parameter.
eta/README.md:16:- Exact integration over the bremsstrahlung photon phase space — no
eta/README.md:17:  peaking approximation.
eta/README.md:18:
eta/README.md:19:The code is extendable to any exclusive two-body electroproduction process,
eta/README.md:20:e.g. p(e,e'K)Λ, d(e,e'p)n, ³He(e,e'p)d.
eta/README.md:21:

eta/README.md:43:## Interactive RC Explorer
eta/README.md:44:
eta/README.md:45:A browser-based visualisation of the η-channel radiative correction output
eta/README.md:46:(δ = σ_obs/σ₀ and A_RC/A_Born) is available at:
eta/README.md:47:
eta/README.md:48:**<https://izzyillari.github.io/exclurad/>**
eta/README.md:49:
eta/README.md:50:The dataset was computed with the η-channel configuration described below
eta/README.md:51:(vcut = 0.166 GeV², beam energy 6.53 GeV, full O(α) corrections) and now
eta/README.md:52:covers the full production grid: W = 1.487–2.211 GeV, Q² = 0.3–5.0 GeV²,
eta/README.md:53:cos θ* = ±0.9, full φ* range — about 1.9 million kinematic points.
eta/README.md:54:Use the sliders to fix two kinematic variables and plot curves overlaid
eta/README.md:55:by a third.

eta/README.md:91:## Getting started
eta/README.md:92:
eta/README.md:93:### Clone
eta/README.md:94:
eta/README.md:95:```bash
eta/README.md:96:git clone https://github.com/JeffersonLab/exclurad.git
eta/README.md:97:cd exclurad
eta/README.md:98:```
eta/README.md:99:
eta/README.md:100:### Build
eta/README.md:101:
eta/README.md:102:```bash
eta/README.md:103:# GNU make
eta/README.md:104:make
eta/README.md:105:
eta/README.md:106:# or SCons (original build system)
eta/README.md:107:scons
eta/README.md:108:```
eta/README.md:109:
eta/README.md:110:The executable is written to `build/exclurad.exe`.
eta/README.md:111:
eta/README.md:112:On the JLab interactive farm (`ifarm`), GNU Fortran (GCC) 11.5.0 is
eta/README.md:113:available at `/usr/bin/gfortran` with no environment modules required.
eta/README.md:114:
eta/README.md:115:### Run a single input
eta/README.md:116:
eta/README.md:117:```bash
eta/README.md:118:./build/exclurad.exe < input.dat
eta/README.md:119:```
eta/README.md:120:
eta/README.md:121:Outputs are written to the current directory: `all.dat`, `allu.dat`,
eta/README.md:122:`radasm.dat`, `radcor.dat`, `radsigmi.dat`, `radsigpl.dat`, `radtot.dat`.
eta/README.md:123:
eta/README.md:124:---
eta/README.md:125:
eta/README.md:126:## Input file format
eta/README.md:127:
eta/README.md:128:```
eta/README.md:129:3       !  1: AO  2: maid98  3: maid2000
eta/README.md:130:0       !  0: Full, 1: Factorizable and Leading log
eta/README.md:131:6.53    !  bmom - lepton momentum [GeV]
eta/README.md:132:0.0     !  tmom - momentum per nucleon
eta/README.md:133:1       !  lepton - 1 electron, 2 muon
eta/README.md:134:1       !  ivec  - detected hadron (1) p, (2) pi+
eta/README.md:135:0.166   !  vcut  - cut on inelasticity [GeV²] (0 = no cut)
eta/README.md:136:
eta/README.md:137:10 ! no. of points
eta/README.md:138:<W values>        ! W [GeV]
eta/README.md:139:<Q² values>       ! Q² [GeV²]
eta/README.md:140:<cos(θ*) values>  ! Cos(Theta*)
eta/README.md:141:<φ* values>       ! phi* [deg]
eta/README.md:142:
eta/README.md:143:0error detected by nag library routine   d01fce - ifail =     2
eta/README.md:144:```
eta/README.md:145:
eta/README.md:146:Key parameters for η electroproduction (ep → e'pη):
eta/README.md:147:
eta/README.md:148:| Parameter | Value | Notes |
eta/README.md:149:|---|---|---|
eta/README.md:150:| `model` | `3` | EtaMAID (maid2000 slot, updated to EtaMAID-2023 tables) |
eta/README.md:151:| `ivec` | `1` | Detected recoil proton |
eta/README.md:152:| `bmom` | `6.53` | CLAS12 beam momentum [GeV] |
eta/README.md:153:| `vcut` | `0.166` | Inelasticity cut [GeV²] used in CLAS12 η analysis |
eta/README.md:154:
eta/README.md:155:The maximum number of points per file is **10** (Fortran reader limit).
eta/README.md:156:For larger grids, use `scripts/rcgrid_inputgen.py` which chunks
eta/README.md:157:automatically. See `examples/README.md` for annotated input files and
eta/README.md:158:`examples/input_multi_chunk.dat` for the multi-row layout used when N > 10.
eta/README.md:159:
eta/README.md:160:---
eta/README.md:161:
eta/README.md:162:## Generating and running a grid
eta/README.md:163:
eta/README.md:164:### 1. Generate inputs
eta/README.md:165:
eta/README.md:166:```bash
eta/README.md:167:python3 scripts/rcgrid_inputgen.py \
eta/README.md:168:  --w-min 1.487 --w-max 1.999 --n-w 30 \
eta/README.md:169:  --q2-min 0.3  --q2-max 4.0  --n-q2 30 \
eta/README.md:170:  --cos-min -0.9 --cos-max 0.9 --n-cos 30 \
eta/README.md:171:  --n-phi 19 \
eta/README.md:172:  --tag my_run
eta/README.md:173:# Output: rcgrid-phi_sweep_grid_my_run_<timestamp>/
eta/README.md:174:```
eta/README.md:175:
eta/README.md:176:See `scripts/README.md` for all flags.
eta/README.md:177:
eta/README.md:178:### 2. Run locally (sequential)
eta/README.md:179:
eta/README.md:180:```bash
eta/README.md:181:./scripts/run_exclurad_grid.sh \
eta/README.md:182:  --input-dir rcgrid-phi_sweep_grid_my_run_...  \
eta/README.md:183:  --work-dir  .
eta/README.md:184:```
eta/README.md:185:
eta/README.md:186:For runs near the η threshold or large |cos θ*|, use the unphysical-skip
eta/README.md:187:runner instead:
eta/README.md:188:
eta/README.md:189:```bash
eta/README.md:190:./scripts/run_exclurad_skip_unphys.sh \
eta/README.md:191:  --input-dir rcgrid-phi_sweep_grid_my_run_...  \
eta/README.md:192:  --work-dir  .                                  \
eta/README.md:193:  --timeout-sec 600
eta/README.md:194:```
eta/README.md:195:
eta/README.md:196:### 3. Run on the JLab farm (Slurm)
eta/README.md:197:
eta/README.md:198:```bash
eta/README.md:199:# Build index
eta/README.md:200:find rcgrid-phi_sweep_grid_my_run_... -name '*.dat' | LC_ALL=C sort > inputs.index
eta/README.md:201:
eta/README.md:202:# Submit array (100 files per task, 50 concurrent)
eta/README.md:203:N=$(wc -l < inputs.index)
eta/README.md:204:TASKS=$(( (N + 99) / 100 - 1 ))
eta/README.md:205:sbatch --array=0-${TASKS}%50 slurm/exclurad_run_chunk.sbatch \
eta/README.md:206:  --index-file   $(pwd)/inputs.index                           \
eta/README.md:207:  --exe-path     $(pwd)/build/exclurad.exe                     \
eta/README.md:208:  --results-root /volatile/clas12/$USER/exclurad/results       \
eta/README.md:209:  --count        100
eta/README.md:210:```
eta/README.md:211:
eta/README.md:212:See `slurm/README.md` for the full set of batch scripts and workflows.
eta/README.md:213:

eta/README.md:215:
eta/README.md:216:## η-channel modifications (2025)
eta/README.md:217:
eta/README.md:218:The following source-level changes were made relative to the original 2002
eta/README.md:219:pion code to support η electroproduction:
eta/README.md:220:
eta/README.md:221:| File | Change |
eta/README.md:222:|---|---|
eta/README.md:223:| `exclurad.F` | η mass, beam energy default, output formatting |
eta/README.md:224:| `mpintp.inc` | Channel constants, grid dimensions for EtaMAID |
eta/README.md:225:| `maid07-PPpi.tbl` | Replaced with EtaMAID-2023 tables (V. Kashevarov) |
eta/README.md:226:| `fint.F` | CERNLIB-free replacement for numerical integration |
eta/README.md:227:
eta/README.md:228:The pion tables (`maid07-NPpi.tbl`, `maid98-PNpi.tbl`, `maid98-PPpi.tbl`)
eta/README.md:229:are no longer included; this repository targets η production only.
eta/README.md:230:The original pion version remains available at the
eta/README.md:231:[JLab RC page](https://www.jlab.org/RC/) and [Exclurad Pion Github Repo](https://github.com/JeffersonLab/exclurad/tree/main).

eta/exclurad.F:209:      subroutine setcon(ivec,lepton)
eta/exclurad.F:210:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:211:      common/cmp/pi,alpha,amp,amp2,ap,ap2,aml2,amu2,amh2,barn

eta/exclurad.F:215:      data amunm/0.54786d0,0.938272d0/
eta/exclurad.F:216:
eta/exclurad.F:217:      if(lepton.eq.1)aml2=.261112d-6

eta/exclurad.F:219:      pi=3.1415926d0
eta/exclurad.F:220:      alpha=.729735d-2
eta/exclurad.F:221:      barn=.389379d6
eta/exclurad.F:222:      amh2=amhad(ivec)**2
eta/exclurad.F:223:      amu2=amunm(ivec)**2
eta/exclurad.F:224:
eta/exclurad.F:225:      amp=.938272d0
eta/exclurad.F:226:      amp2=amp**2
eta/exclurad.F:227:      ap=2d0*amp
eta/exclurad.F:228:      ap2=2d0*amp2
eta/exclurad.F:229:
eta/exclurad.F:230:

eta/exclurad.F:235:****************** bornkin *************************************
eta/exclurad.F:236:
eta/exclurad.F:237:      subroutine bornkin(cutv)
eta/exclurad.F:238:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:239:      common/cmp/pi,alpha,amp,amp2,ap,ap2,aml2,amu2,amh2,barn
eta/exclurad.F:240:      common/born/w,w2,q2,s,x,sx,sxp,sqlw0,ssh0,xxh0,sxtm0,sqll
eta/exclurad.F:241:     .	   ,cosh,phih,sinh,vmax,vv10,vv20,vvp0,vvm0,t0 !  /born/
eta/exclurad.F:242:     .	   ,cos1,sin1,cos2,sin2,ee1,ee2,pp1,pp2,eeq,ppq !  /born/
eta/exclurad.F:243:
eta/exclurad.F:244:      w2=w**2
eta/exclurad.F:245:      sx=w2+q2-amp2
eta/exclurad.F:246:      x=s-sx
eta/exclurad.F:247:      sxp=s+x
eta/exclurad.F:248:      aly=sx**2+4.*amp2*q2
eta/exclurad.F:249:      sqly=dsqrt(aly)
eta/exclurad.F:250:      eeq=(sx-2.*q2)/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:251:      ppq=sqly/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:252:
eta/exclurad.F:253:      vmax=w2-amu2+amh2-2.*sqrt(w2)*sqrt(amh2)	- 1d-8
eta/exclurad.F:254:      if(cutv.gt.1d-12)vmax=min(vmax,cutv)
eta/exclurad.F:255:
eta/exclurad.F:256:
eta/exclurad.F:257:      u1=s-q2
eta/exclurad.F:258:      u2=x+q2
eta/exclurad.F:259:      ee1=u1/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:260:      ee2=u2/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:261:      sql1=sqrt(u1**2-4.*w2*aml2)
eta/exclurad.F:262:      sql2=sqrt(u2**2-4.*w2*aml2)
eta/exclurad.F:263:      pp1=sql1/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:264:      pp2=sql2/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:265:      cos1=(u1*(sx-2.*q2)+2.*q2*w2)/sqly/sql1
eta/exclurad.F:266:      cos2=(u2*(sx-2.*q2)-2.*q2*w2)/sqly/sql2
eta/exclurad.F:267:      sql12=sqrt(q2*u1*u2-q2**2*w2-aml2*aly)
eta/exclurad.F:268:      sin1=2.*w*sql12/sql1/sqly
eta/exclurad.F:269:      sin2=2.*w*sql12/sql2/sqly
eta/exclurad.F:270:      sqll=sqrt(q2*u1*u2-q2**2*w2-aml2*aly)
eta/exclurad.F:271:
eta/exclurad.F:272:
eta/exclurad.F:273:      sinh=sqrt(1d0-cosh**2)
eta/exclurad.F:274:      eeh0=(w2+amh2-amu2)/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:275:      sqlw0=sqrt((w2+amh2-amu2)**2-4.*w2*amh2)
eta/exclurad.F:276:      pph0=sqlw0/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:277:
eta/exclurad.F:278:      vv10=2d0*(ee1*eeh0-pp1*pph0*(cosh*cos1+sinh*sin1*cos(phih)))
eta/exclurad.F:279:      vv20=2d0*(ee2*eeh0-pp2*pph0*(cosh*cos2+sinh*sin2*cos(phih)))
eta/exclurad.F:280:
eta/exclurad.F:281:      ssh0=x+q2-vv20
eta/exclurad.F:282:      xxh0=s-q2-vv10
eta/exclurad.F:283:      t0=-q2-vv10+vv20+amh2
eta/exclurad.F:284:
eta/exclurad.F:285:      sxtm0=sx+t0+amp2-amu2
eta/exclurad.F:286:
eta/exclurad.F:287:c     write(*,'(a8,2g11.3)')' test1: ',sin1**2+cos1**2
eta/exclurad.F:288:c     write(*,'(a8,2g11.3)')' test2: ',sin2**2+cos2**2
eta/exclurad.F:289:c     write(*,'(a8,2g11.3)')' test3: ',sinh**2+cosh**2
eta/exclurad.F:290:c     write(*,'(a8,2g11.3)')' test4: ',pph0**2+amh2,eeh0**2
eta/exclurad.F:291:c     write(*,'(a8,2g11.3)')' test5: ',pp1**2+aml2,ee1**2
eta/exclurad.F:292:c     write(*,'(a8,2g11.3)')' test6: ',pp2**2+aml2,ee2**2
eta/exclurad.F:293:c     write(*,'(a8,2g11.3)')' test7: ',ppq**2-eeq**2,q2
eta/exclurad.F:294:c     write(*,'(a8,2g11.3)')' test8: ',w2+amh2-2.*w*eeh0,amu2
eta/exclurad.F:295:
eta/exclurad.F:296:      end

eta/exclurad.F:298:****************** borntest *************************************
eta/exclurad.F:299:      subroutine borntest(bmom,w,q2,csin,phih,sig0bu,sig0bp,eps_d)
eta/exclurad.F:300:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:301:      common/cmp/pi,alpha,amp,amp2,ap,ap2,aml2,amu2,amh2,barn
eta/exclurad.F:302:      common/keys/ivec,iphy
eta/exclurad.F:303:
eta/exclurad.F:304:	enu = 0.5d0*(w**2+q2-amp2)/amp
eta/exclurad.F:305:	bmom_prime = bmom - enu
eta/exclurad.F:306:	cthe = 1.d0-q2/(2.0*bmom*bmom_prime)
eta/exclurad.F:307:	the_e = acos(cthe)
eta/exclurad.F:308:	eps_d= 1d0/(1d0+2d0*(1d0+enu*enu/q2)*tan(0.5d0*the_e)**2)
eta/exclurad.F:309:
eta/exclurad.F:310:	call phy_model(iphy,q2,w,csin
eta/exclurad.F:311:     .	 ,2*ivec-1,sig_t,sig_l,sig_tt,sig_lt,sig_ltp)
eta/exclurad.F:312:
eta/exclurad.F:313:c	write(*,'(5g12.4)')q2,w,csin
eta/exclurad.F:314:c	 write(*,'(5g12.4)')sig_t,sig_l,sig_tt,sig_lt,sig_ltp
eta/exclurad.F:315:
eta/exclurad.F:316:
eta/exclurad.F:317:c	 sig_t=0.
eta/exclurad.F:318:c	 sig_l=0.
eta/exclurad.F:319:c	 sig_tt=0.
eta/exclurad.F:320:c	 sig_lt=0.
eta/exclurad.F:321:
eta/exclurad.F:322:	sig0b = sig_t + eps_d*sig_l + eps_d*sig_tt*cos(2d0*phih)
eta/exclurad.F:323:     .	 + sqrt(eps_d*(eps_d+1d0)/2d0)*sig_lt*cos(phih)
eta/exclurad.F:324:	sig0b=sig0b * alpha/2d0/pi*bmom_prime/bmom*(w**2-amp2)
eta/exclurad.F:325:     .	 /2./amp/q2/(1d0-eps_d)
eta/exclurad.F:326:
eta/exclurad.F:327:	sig0bu=sig0b*pi/2./amp/bmom/bmom_prime
eta/exclurad.F:328:
eta/exclurad.F:329:	sig0b =
eta/exclurad.F:330:     .	 + sqrt(eps_d*(-eps_d+1d0)/2d0)*sig_ltp*sin(phih)
eta/exclurad.F:331:	sig0b=sig0b * alpha/2d0/pi*bmom_prime/bmom*(w**2-amp2)
eta/exclurad.F:332:     .	 /2./amp/q2/(1d0-eps_d)
eta/exclurad.F:333:
eta/exclurad.F:334:	sig0bp=sig0b*pi/2./amp/bmom/bmom_prime
eta/exclurad.F:335:
eta/exclurad.F:336:      end

eta/exclurad.F:340:
eta/exclurad.F:341:      subroutine bornin(sibor)
eta/exclurad.F:342:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:343:      common/cmp/pi,alpha,amp,amp2,ap,ap2,aml2,amu2,amh2,barn
eta/exclurad.F:344:      common/born/w,w2,q2,s,x,sx,sxp,sqlw0,ssh0,xxh0,sxtm0,sqll
eta/exclurad.F:345:     .	   ,cosh,phih,sinh,vmax,vv10,vv20,vvp0,vvm0,t0	!  /born/
eta/exclurad.F:346:     .	   ,cos1,sin1,cos2,sin2,ee1,ee2,pp1,pp2,eeq,ppq !  /born/
eta/exclurad.F:347:      dimension tb(5),sfm0(5)
eta/exclurad.F:348:      common/isfisf/isf1,isf2
eta/exclurad.F:349:
eta/exclurad.F:350:       call subtm0(5,tb)
eta/exclurad.F:351:       call sffun(sfm0,q2,w2,t0)
eta/exclurad.F:352:
eta/exclurad.F:353:       ssu=0d0
eta/exclurad.F:354:       do isf=isf1,isf2
eta/exclurad.F:355:	  ssu=ssu+tb(isf)*sfm0(isf)
eta/exclurad.F:356:       enddo
eta/exclurad.F:357:
eta/exclurad.F:358:       sibor=alpha**2*sqlw0/(32.*pi**2*w2*s**2*q2**2) * ssu
eta/exclurad.F:359:

eta/exclurad.F:469:      real*8 function fvll(v)
eta/exclurad.F:470:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:471:      common/cmp/pi,alpha,amp,amp2,ap,ap2,aml2,amu2,amh2,barn
eta/exclurad.F:472:      common/born/w,w2,q2,s,x,sx,sxp,sqlw0,ssh0,xxh0,sxtm0,sqll
eta/exclurad.F:473:     .	   ,cosh,phih,sinh,vmax,vv10,vv20,vvp0,vvm0,t0 !  /born/
eta/exclurad.F:474:     .	   ,cos1,sin1,cos2,sin2,ee1,ee2,pp1,pp2,eeq,ppq !  /born/
eta/exclurad.F:475:
eta/exclurad.F:476:      eeh=(w2+amh2-amu2-v)/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:477:      sqlw=sqrt((w2+amh2-amu2-v)**2-4.*w2*amh2)
eta/exclurad.F:478:      pph=sqlw/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:479:      vv1=2d0*(ee1*eeh-pp1*pph*(cosh*cos1+sinh*sin1*cos(phih)))
eta/exclurad.F:480:      vv2=2d0*(ee2*eeh-pp2*pph*(cosh*cos2+sinh*sin2*cos(phih)))
eta/exclurad.F:481:
eta/exclurad.F:482:      tt=(-q2+amh2-vv1+vv2)
eta/exclurad.F:483:
eta/exclurad.F:484:      sxtm=sx+tt-v+amp2-amu2
eta/exclurad.F:485:
eta/exclurad.F:486:
eta/exclurad.F:487:      xx=x+q2-vv2
eta/exclurad.F:488:      ss=s-q2-vv1
eta/exclurad.F:489:
eta/exclurad.F:490:      z1=1d0-v/ss
eta/exclurad.F:491:      z2=1d0/(1d0+v/xx)
eta/exclurad.F:492:
eta/exclurad.F:493:       sigmas=sigm5(z1*s,x,z1*q2,z1*vv1,vv2,sinh,phih)
eta/exclurad.F:494:       sigmax=sigm5(s,x/z2,q2/z2,vv1,vv2/z2,sinh,phih)
eta/exclurad.F:495:       sigma0=sigm5(s,x,q2,vv1,vv2,sinh,phih)
eta/exclurad.F:496:
eta/exclurad.F:497:       w2s=z1*s-x-z1*q2+amp2
eta/exclurad.F:498:       w2x=s-x/z2-q2/z2+amp2
eta/exclurad.F:499:
eta/exclurad.F:500:
eta/exclurad.F:501:      sqlws0=sqrt((w2s+amh2-amu2)**2-4.*w2s*amh2)
eta/exclurad.F:502:      sqlwx0=sqrt((w2x+amh2-amu2)**2-4.*w2x*amh2)
eta/exclurad.F:503:
eta/exclurad.F:504:       ccs=sqlw/sqlws0*w2s/w2
eta/exclurad.F:505:       ccx=sqlw/sqlwx0*w2x/w2
eta/exclurad.F:506:
eta/exclurad.F:507:      sis=((1d0+z1**2)*ccs*sigmas-2d0*sigma0)/ss/(1d0-z1)
eta/exclurad.F:508:      six=((1d0+z2**2)*ccx*sigmax-2d0*sigma0)*z2/xx/(1d0-z2)
eta/exclurad.F:509:
eta/exclurad.F:510:      fvll=alpha/2d0/pi*(log(Q2/aml2)-1d0)*(sis+six)
eta/exclurad.F:511:
eta/exclurad.F:512:c     write(33,'(5g12.3)')z1,z2,v
eta/exclurad.F:513:c      pause
eta/exclurad.F:514:
eta/exclurad.F:515:      end

eta/exclurad.F:577:      double precision function rv2tr(ndim,arg)
eta/exclurad.F:578:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:579:      dimension arg(ndim),tm(5,3),tb(5),sfm(5),sfm0(5)
eta/exclurad.F:580:      common/cmp/pi,alpha,amp,amp2,ap,ap2,aml2,amu2,amh2,barn

eta/exclurad.F:584:      common/isfisf/isf1,isf2
eta/exclurad.F:585:
eta/exclurad.F:586:
eta/exclurad.F:587:      phik=arg(3)
eta/exclurad.F:588:      cosk=arg(2)
eta/exclurad.F:589:      vv=arg(1)
eta/exclurad.F:590:
eta/exclurad.F:591:      sink2=1.d0-cosk**2
eta/exclurad.F:592:      sink=sqrt(max(0d0,sink2))
eta/exclurad.F:593:
eta/exclurad.F:594:      z1=(ee1-pp1*(cos1*cosk+sin1*sink*cos(phik)))/w
eta/exclurad.F:595:      z2=(ee2-pp2*(cos2*cosk+sin2*sink*cos(phik)))/w
eta/exclurad.F:596:       bb=1.
eta/exclurad.F:597:       bi12=bb/(z1*z2)
eta/exclurad.F:598:       bi1pi2=bb/z2+bb/z1
eta/exclurad.F:599:       bis=(bb/z2**2+bb/z1**2)*aml2
eta/exclurad.F:600:       bir=(bb/z2**2-bb/z1**2)*aml2
eta/exclurad.F:601:       bi22m=bb/z2**2*aml2
eta/exclurad.F:602:       bi11m=bb/z1**2*aml2
eta/exclurad.F:603:       hi2=bis-q2*bi12
eta/exclurad.F:604:
eta/exclurad.F:605:      eeh=(w2+amh2-amu2-vv)/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:606:      sqlw=sqrt((w2+amh2-amu2-vv)**2-4.*w2*amh2)
eta/exclurad.F:607:      pph=sqlw/2./w
eta/exclurad.F:608:      vv1=2d0*(ee1*eeh-pp1*pph*(cosh*cos1+sinh*sin1*cos(phih)))
eta/exclurad.F:609:      vv2=2d0*(ee2*eeh-pp2*pph*(cosh*cos2+sinh*sin2*cos(phih)))
eta/exclurad.F:610:      fwiw=1d0-(eeh-pph*(cosh*cosk+sinh*sink*cos(phih-phik)))/w
eta/exclurad.F:611:
eta/exclurad.F:612:      ta=(eeq-ppq*cosk)/w
eta/exclurad.F:613:      dmu=1d0-fwiw
eta/exclurad.F:614:      r=vv/fwiw
eta/exclurad.F:615:
eta/exclurad.F:616:      tt=-q2+amh2-vv1+vv2
eta/exclurad.F:617:
eta/exclurad.F:618:      tldq2=q2+r*ta
eta/exclurad.F:619:      tldw2=w2-r
eta/exclurad.F:620:      tldtm=(-q2+amh2-vv1+vv2)-r*(ta-dmu)
eta/exclurad.F:621:      tldtm=tt-r*(ta-dmu)
eta/exclurad.F:622:
eta/exclurad.F:623:c	write(22,'(a5,7g11.3)')' tri ',eeh/w,pph/w
eta/exclurad.F:624:c     .  ,w-eeh-r/2./w,sqrt(amu2)
eta/exclurad.F:625:c     .  ,fwiw
eta/exclurad.F:626:
eta/exclurad.F:627:       call sffun(sfm,tldq2,tldw2,tldtm)
eta/exclurad.F:628:       call sffun(sfm0,q2,w2,t0)
eta/exclurad.F:629:
eta/exclurad.F:630:
eta/exclurad.F:631:      sxtm=sx+tt-vv+amp2-amu2
eta/exclurad.F:632:
eta/exclurad.F:633:      vpl=vv1+vv2
eta/exclurad.F:634:      vmi=vv1-vv2
eta/exclurad.F:635:
eta/exclurad.F:636:       call subtm0(5,tb)
eta/exclurad.F:637:
eta/exclurad.F:638:c     TM(1,1)=4.*HI2*Q2
eta/exclurad.F:639:c     TM(1,2)=4.*HI2*TA
eta/exclurad.F:640:c     TM(1,3)=2.*(-2.*BB-BI12*TA**2)
eta/exclurad.F:641:c     TM(2,1)=(HI2*(-4.*AMP2*Q2+SXP**2-SX**2))/2.
eta/exclurad.F:642:c     TM(2,2)=(-4.*AMP2*HI2*TA-BI12*SXP**2*TA+BI1PI2*SXP*SX+2.*
eta/exclurad.F:643:c    . BIR*SXP+2.*HI2*SX)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:644:c     TM(2,3)=(4.*AMP2*BB+2.*AMP2*BI12*TA**2-BI12*SX*TA-BI1PI2*
eta/exclurad.F:645:c    . SXP)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:646:c     TM(3,1)=(HI2*(-4.*AMH2*Q2-VMI**2+VPL**2))/2.
eta/exclurad.F:647:c     TM(3,2)=(-4.*AMH2*HI2*TA-BI12*TA*VPL**2+BI1PI2*VMI*VPL+2.*
eta/exclurad.F:648:c    . BIR*DMU*VPL+2.*DMU*HI2*VMI)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:649:c     TM(3,3)=(4.*AMH2*BB+2.*AMH2*BI12*TA**2-BI12*DMU*TA*VMI-
eta/exclurad.F:650:c    . BI1PI2*DMU*VPL)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:651:c     TM(4,1)=HI2*(-2.*Q2*SXTM+SXP*VPL-SX*VMI)
eta/exclurad.F:652:c     TM(4,2)=(-2.*BI12*SXP*TA*VPL+BI1PI2*SXP*VMI+BI1PI2*SX*VPL+
eta/exclurad.F:653:c    . 2.*BIR*DMU*SXP+2.*BIR*VPL+2.*DMU*HI2*SX-4.*HI2*SXTM*TA+2.*
eta/exclurad.F:654:c    . HI2*VMI)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:655:c     TM(4,3)=(4.*BB*SXTM-BI12*DMU*SX*TA+2.*BI12*SXTM*TA**2-BI12
eta/exclurad.F:656:c    . *TA*VMI-BI1PI2*DMU*SXP-BI1PI2*VPL)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:657:
eta/exclurad.F:658:
eta/exclurad.F:659:      v1=vv1
eta/exclurad.F:660:      v2=vv2

eta/exclurad.F:767:      subroutine sffun(sfm,q2,w2,t)
eta/exclurad.F:768:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)

eta/exclurad.F:770:      common/keys/ivec,iphy

eta/exclurad.F:773:      sqw2=sqrt(w2)

eta/exclurad.F:776:      sx=w2+q2-amp2
eta/exclurad.F:777:      aly=sx**2+4.*amp2*q2
eta/exclurad.F:778:      sxt=sx+t+amp2-amu2
eta/exclurad.F:779:      tq=t+q2-amh2
eta/exclurad.F:780:
eta/exclurad.F:781:      sqlw=sqrt((W2-amu2-amh2)**2-4.*amu2*amh2)
eta/exclurad.F:782:      sqll=sqrt(q2*sxt**2-sxt*sx*tq-amp2*tq**2-amh2*aly)
eta/exclurad.F:783:
eta/exclurad.F:784:      csthcm=(2.*tq*w2+(sx-2.*q2)*(w2+amh2-amu2))/sqlw/sqrt(aly)
eta/exclurad.F:785:
eta/exclurad.F:786:c      write(22,'(7g11.3)')q2,w2,t
eta/exclurad.F:787:
eta/exclurad.F:788:      if(ivec.eq.1)then
eta/exclurad.F:789:	cspion=-csthcm
eta/exclurad.F:790:      elseif(ivec.eq.2)then
eta/exclurad.F:791:	cspion= csthcm
eta/exclurad.F:792:      endif
eta/exclurad.F:793:
eta/exclurad.F:794:      call phy_model(iphy,q2,sqw2,cspion,iepi,st,sl,stt,slt,sltp)
eta/exclurad.F:795:
eta/exclurad.F:796:cc	write(*,'(5g12.4)')q2,sqw2,cspion
eta/exclurad.F:797:c	write(*,'(5g12.4)')st,sl,stt,slt,sltp
eta/exclurad.F:798:c      write(22,'(7g11.3)')q2,sqw2,cspion,st,sl,stt,slt
eta/exclurad.F:799:
eta/exclurad.F:800:c	stt=0.
eta/exclurad.F:801:c      slt=0.
eta/exclurad.F:802:c	st=0.
eta/exclurad.F:803:c	sl=0.
eta/exclurad.F:804:
eta/exclurad.F:805:
eta/exclurad.F:806:      if(ivec.eq.1)then
eta/exclurad.F:807:	 slt=-slt
eta/exclurad.F:808:	 sltp=-sltp
eta/exclurad.F:809:      endif
eta/exclurad.F:810:
eta/exclurad.F:811:      sfm10=(st-stt)
eta/exclurad.F:812:      sfm20=4.*(st+sl)*q2/aly
eta/exclurad.F:813:      sfm2tl=2.*slt*sqrt(q2)*(-sx*tq+2*q2*sxt)/(aly*sqll)
eta/exclurad.F:814:      sfm4tl=-slt*sqrt(q2)/sqll
eta/exclurad.F:815:      sfm4tt=-2.*stt*(-sx*tq+2*q2*sxt)/sqll**2
eta/exclurad.F:816:      sfm3tt=2.*stt*aly/sqll**2
eta/exclurad.F:817:      sfm2tt=2.*stt*((-sx*tq+2*q2*sxt)**2-2*q2*sqll**2)/(aly*sqll**2)
eta/exclurad.F:818:      sfm5tl=-sltp*sqrt(q2)/sqll
eta/exclurad.F:819:
eta/exclurad.F:820:
eta/exclurad.F:821:       coetr=16.*pi**2*(w2-amp2)*w2/(alpha*sqlw)
eta/exclurad.F:822:
eta/exclurad.F:823:       sfm(1)=coetr*sfm10
eta/exclurad.F:824:       sfm(2)=coetr*(sfm20+sfm2tl+sfm2tt)
eta/exclurad.F:825:       sfm(3)=coetr*sfm3tt
eta/exclurad.F:826:       sfm(4)=coetr*(sfm4tl+sfm4tt)
eta/exclurad.F:827:       sfm(5)=coetr*sfm5tl
eta/exclurad.F:828:
eta/exclurad.F:829:c	 write(*,*)q2,w2,t,sfm
eta/exclurad.F:830:c	pause
eta/exclurad.F:831:
eta/exclurad.F:832:      end

eta/exclurad.F:1156:	 COMPLEX FUNCTION EPRES(IREA,XMP,XMPI,W,W0,GAM,X,L,J,ISO,
eta/exclurad.F:1157:     *	 PIMP,GENER,TSTS11)
eta/exclurad.F:1158:	 COMPLEX QETA,GAMMAT,Q0ETA
eta/exclurad.F:1159:	 INTEGER L,J,ISO,IREA
eta/exclurad.F:1160:	 REAL XMP,XMPI,W,W0,GAM,X,PIMP0
eta/exclurad.F:1161:	 REAL PENER0,GENER0,XMETA,GAMMA
eta/exclurad.F:1162:	 LOGICAL TSTS11
eta/exclurad.F:1163:	 COMPLEX IM
eta/exclurad.F:1164:	 DATA IM/(0.,1.)/
eta/exclurad.F:1165:	 DATA XMETA/.5488/
eta/exclurad.F:1166:
eta/exclurad.F:1167:	 PENER0=(W0**2-XMP**2+XMPI**2)/(2.*W0)
eta/exclurad.F:1168:	 PIMP0 = SQRT ( PENER0**2 - XMPI**2 )
eta/exclurad.F:1169:	 GENER0 = (W0**2-XMP**2)/(2.*W0)
eta/exclurad.F:1170:	 if (PIMP0 .le. 0.)then
eta/exclurad.F:1171:	    write(6,*)' epres: pimp0 =',PIMP0
eta/exclurad.F:1172:	    PIMP0=abs(PIMP0)
eta/exclurad.F:1173:	 endif
eta/exclurad.F:1174:
eta/exclurad.F:1175:	 GAMMA=GAM * ((PIMP/PIMP0)**(2.*L+1))*
eta/exclurad.F:1176:     *	 (((PIMP0**2+X**2)/(PIMP**2+X**2))**L)
eta/exclurad.F:1177:
eta/exclurad.F:1178:	 GAMMAG=GAM * ((GENER/GENER0)**(2.*J))*
eta/exclurad.F:1179:     *	 (((GENER0**2+X**2)/(GENER**2+X**2))**J)
eta/exclurad.F:1180:
eta/exclurad.F:1181:	 IF(TSTS11)THEN
eta/exclurad.F:1182:	   XETA=(W**2-XMP**2+XMETA**2)/(2.*W)
eta/exclurad.F:1183:	   XETA=XETA**2-XMETA**2
eta/exclurad.F:1184:	   IF(XETA.GE.0.)THEN
eta/exclurad.F:1185:	  QETA=CMPLX(SQRT(XETA),0.)
eta/exclurad.F:1186:	   ELSE
eta/exclurad.F:1187:	     QETA=CMPLX(0.,SQRT(-XETA))
eta/exclurad.F:1188:	   END IF
eta/exclurad.F:1189:	  Q0ETA=(W0**2-XMP**2+XMETA**2)/(2.*W0)
eta/exclurad.F:1190:	  Q0ETA=SQRT(Q0ETA**2-XMETA**2)
eta/exclurad.F:1191:	  GAMMAT=GAM*(.55*(QETA/Q0ETA)+.4*(PIMP/PIMP0)+.05)
eta/exclurad.F:1192:C	     GAMMAT=GAM*(PIMP/PIMP0)
eta/exclurad.F:1193:	   ELSE
eta/exclurad.F:1194:	    GAMMAT=CMPLX(GAMMA,0.)
eta/exclurad.F:1195:	  END IF
eta/exclurad.F:1196:	 EPRES=SQRT((GENER0*PIMP0)/(GENER*PIMP))
eta/exclurad.F:1197:	 EPRES=EPRES*W0*SQRT(GAMMA*GAMMAG)
eta/exclurad.F:1198:	 EPRES=EPRES/(W0**2-W**2-IM*W0*GAMMAT)
eta/exclurad.F:1199:	 IF(IREA.EQ.1.OR.IREA.EQ.2)THEN
eta/exclurad.F:1200:	   IF(ISO.EQ.1)THEN
eta/exclurad.F:1201:	     EPRES=-EPRES/SQRT(2.)
eta/exclurad.F:1202:	   ELSE
eta/exclurad.F:1203:	     EPRES=EPRES*SQRT(2.)
eta/exclurad.F:1204:	   END IF
eta/exclurad.F:1205:	 END IF

eta/exclurad.F:1902:* DEVELOPED IN END OF SEPT. 1992 Z.LI
eta/exclurad.F:1903:* With IFLAG and VFLAG both equal to 0, we calculate electric born only
eta/exclurad.F:1904:* Both neutron and proton form factor took from original program hborn.
eta/exclurad.F:1905:* The axial form factor may not correct.
eta/exclurad.F:1906:* A cut off factor is added for the born terms when the center of
eta/exclurad.F:1907:* mass energy is larger than 1.3 GEV:
eta/exclurad.F:1908:* Fcut=cut**2/(cut**2-(w-1.3)**2), cut is set to 0.4
eta/exclurad.F:1909:**************************************************************************
eta/exclurad.F:1910:       SUBROUTINE BORNT(Q2,W,SINX,COSX,SINX2,COSX2,BORN,IR,CUT)
eta/exclurad.F:1911:       implicit none
eta/exclurad.F:1912:       real q2,w,sinx,cosx,sinx2,cosx2,cut
eta/exclurad.F:1913:       integer ir
eta/exclurad.F:1914:       real xmpip,xmpi0,xmpi,xmp,up,un,ec,gn
eta/exclurad.F:1915:       real BORN(6),GAMMA(6,3)
eta/exclurad.F:1916:       real A(6,3),AR(6),FR(6),F1(3),F2(3),FP(3),F2A(3)
eta/exclurad.F:1917:       real C(6),B(6,6),ETA(6),EPS(3)
eta/exclurad.F:1918:       real pi
eta/exclurad.F:1919:       real s,q0,e1,e2,p,p0,t,u,sq2
eta/exclurad.F:1920:       real gg,gep,cap,f1p,f1n,f2p,f2n,f1v,f1s,f2v,f2s
eta/exclurad.F:1921:       real q,z1,z2,fc,pq,fcut
eta/exclurad.F:1922:       integer iflag
eta/exclurad.F:1923:       real vflag
eta/exclurad.F:1924:       integer i,j
eta/exclurad.F:1925:
eta/exclurad.F:1926:       DATA XMPIP/0.54786/,XMPI0/0.54786/,XMP/0.93827/
eta/exclurad.F:1927:       DATA UP,UN/1.793,-1.913/
eta/exclurad.F:1928:       DATA EC/.302862/,GN/13.5/
eta/exclurad.F:1929:       DATA ETA/1.,1.,-1.,1.,-1.,-1./,EPS/1.,1.,-1./
eta/exclurad.F:1930:       DATA IFLAG/0/,VFLAG/0./
eta/exclurad.F:1931:C* IFLAG=0, VFLAG=0. WOULD GET RIDE OF MAGNETIC AND PV EXTRA TERM
eta/exclurad.F:1932:C* RESPECTIVELY.
eta/exclurad.F:1933:       IF(IR.EQ.1.OR.IR.EQ.2)XMPI=XMPI0
eta/exclurad.F:1934:       IF(IR.EQ.3.OR.IR.EQ.4)XMPI=XMPIP
eta/exclurad.F:1935:       PI=4.0*ATAN(1.0)
eta/exclurad.F:1936:       GG=SQRT(4.*PI*GN)
eta/exclurad.F:1937:C*  THE PI-N COUPLING CONSTANT
eta/exclurad.F:1938:       GEP=1./(1.+3.04*Q2+1.54*Q2*Q2+0.068*Q2*Q2*Q2)
eta/exclurad.F:1939:       CAP=Q2/(4.*XMP*XMP)
eta/exclurad.F:1940:       F1P=EC*GEP*(1.+(1.+UP)*CAP)/(1.+CAP)
eta/exclurad.F:1941:       F1N=EC*GEP*UN*CAP/(1.+CAP)
eta/exclurad.F:1942:       IF(IFLAG.EQ.0) THEN
eta/exclurad.F:1943:	 F2P=0.
eta/exclurad.F:1944:	 F2N=0.
eta/exclurad.F:1945:       ELSE
eta/exclurad.F:1946:	 F2P=EC/(2.*XMP)*GEP*UP/(1.+CAP)
eta/exclurad.F:1947:	 F2N=EC/(2.*XMP)*GEP*UN/(1.+CAP)
eta/exclurad.F:1948:       END IF
eta/exclurad.F:1949:       F1V=F1P-F1N
eta/exclurad.F:1950:       F1S=F1P+F1N
eta/exclurad.F:1951:       F2V=F2P-F2N
eta/exclurad.F:1952:       F2S=F2P+F2N
eta/exclurad.F:1953:       F1(1)=F1V
eta/exclurad.F:1954:       F1(2)=F1S
eta/exclurad.F:1955:       F1(3)=F1V
eta/exclurad.F:1956:       F2(1)=F2V
eta/exclurad.F:1957:       F2(2)=F2S
eta/exclurad.F:1958:       F2(3)=F2V
eta/exclurad.F:1959:C* 1,3,2, CORESSPONDING TO THE ISOVECTOR (+,-) AND ISOSCALAR (0).
eta/exclurad.F:1960:       FP(3)=EC/(1.+Q2/0.5)
eta/exclurad.F:1961:       FP(1)=0.
eta/exclurad.F:1962:       FP(2)=0.
eta/exclurad.F:1963:C* PION FORM FACTOR.
eta/exclurad.F:1964:       S=W**2
eta/exclurad.F:1965:       Q0=(S-XMP**2-Q2)/(2.*W)
eta/exclurad.F:1966:       Q=SQRT(Q2+Q0**2)
eta/exclurad.F:1967:       E1=(S+XMP**2+Q2)/(2.*W)
eta/exclurad.F:1968:       E2=(S+XMP**2-XMPI**2)/(2.*W)
eta/exclurad.F:1969:       P=SQRT(E2**2-XMP**2)
eta/exclurad.F:1970:       P0=SQRT(P**2+XMPI**2)
eta/exclurad.F:1971:       T=2.*Q*P*COSX-2.*Q0*P0+XMPI**2-Q2
eta/exclurad.F:1972:       U=-2.*Q*P*COSX-2.*Q0*E2+XMP**2-Q2
eta/exclurad.F:1973:       DO 15,J=1,3
eta/exclurad.F:1974:	 GAMMA(1,J)=0.5*GG*F1(J)
eta/exclurad.F:1975:	 GAMMA(2,J)=-GG*F1(J)/(T-XMPI**2)

eta/exclurad.F:2046:       B(4,6)=0.

eta/exclurad.F:2049:     C	 (2.*(S-XMP**2)+Q2))

eta/exclurad.F:2052:       B(5,5)=P0*Q2-Q0*PQ
eta/exclurad.F:2053:       B(5,6)=-(E1-XMP)*(W+XMP)
eta/exclurad.F:2054:       B(6,1)=E1+XMP
eta/exclurad.F:2055:       B(6,2)=-B(5,2)

eta/exclurad.F:2057:       B(6,4)=-PQ-P0*(W+XMP)+(E1+XMP)*(W-XMP)
eta/exclurad.F:2058:       B(6,5)=-B(5,5)
eta/exclurad.F:2059:       B(6,6)=-(E1+XMP)*(W-XMP)

eta/exclurad.F:2075:       DO 75, I=1,6

eta/exclurad.F:2091:C* PUT THE FOLLOWING TO USE THE COUPLING CONSTANT GIVEN IN DATA STATEMENT

eta/exclurad.F:2093:		  QME11 = 3.  * DIP_EVF

eta/exclurad.F:2990:       EPH1   =SUBB1*(	     -P2S2   )

eta/exclurad.F:3060:     *		  +CABS(EPH3   )**2
eta/exclurad.F:3061:     *		  +CABS(EPH4   )**2)/2
eta/exclurad.F:3062:C
eta/exclurad.F:3063:C	     Next the transverse polarized term
eta/exclurad.F:3064:C
eta/exclurad.F:3065:	   SIGT   =REAL(EPH2   *CONJG(EPH3   )
eta/exclurad.F:3066:     *		  -	EPH1   *CONJG(EPH4   ))
eta/exclurad.F:3067:C
eta/exclurad.F:3068:C	      And the longitudinal term
eta/exclurad.F:3069:C
eta/exclurad.F:3070:	   SIGL   =CABS(EPH5   )**2
eta/exclurad.F:3071:     *		  +CABS(EPH6   )**2
eta/exclurad.F:3072:C
eta/exclurad.F:3073:C	      Finally, the longitudinal-transverse interference term
eta/exclurad.F:3074:C
eta/exclurad.F:3075:	   SIGI   =SQ2*REAL(EPH5   *CONJG(EPH4	 -EPH1	 )
eta/exclurad.F:3076:     *		  +	    EPH6   *CONJG(EPH3	 +EPH2	 ))
eta/exclurad.F:3077:C
eta/exclurad.F:3078:       SIGIP  =SQ2*AIMAG(EPH5	*CONJG(EPH4   -EPH1   )
eta/exclurad.F:3079:     *	      + 	EPH6   *CONJG(EPH3   +EPH2   ))
eta/exclurad.F:3080:C
eta/exclurad.F:3081:C
eta/exclurad.F:3082:C	       Sum up all the unpolarized cross section terms
eta/exclurad.F:3083:C
eta/exclurad.F:3084:
eta/exclurad.F:3085:	     sig0  = SIGU + EPEPS*SIGL
eta/exclurad.F:3086:c	     print *,SIGT,SIGI,SIGU,SIGL
eta/exclurad.F:3087:	   SIGMAO   = sig0
eta/exclurad.F:3088:     *		   +EPEPS*SIGT*COS(EPPHI*PI/90.)
eta/exclurad.F:3089:     *		   +SQRT(EPEPS*(1+EPEPS)/2.)*SIGI
eta/exclurad.F:3090:     *		   *COS(EPPHI*PI/180.)
eta/exclurad.F:3091:
eta/exclurad.F:3092:
eta/exclurad.F:3093:
eta/exclurad.F:3094:C
eta/exclurad.F:3095:	 if(POL_ELEC .eq. 0. .and. POL_TARG .eq. 0.)then
eta/exclurad.F:3096:	    sigmao=sigmao*FKT
eta/exclurad.F:3097:
eta/exclurad.F:3098:	    return
eta/exclurad.F:3099:	 endif
eta/exclurad.F:3100:
eta/exclurad.F:3101:
eta/exclurad.F:3102:
eta/exclurad.F:3103:C
eta/exclurad.F:3104:C	       Convert Walker amplitudes to Bartl & Majerotto spin-flip and non spin-flip amplitudes
eta/exclurad.F:3105:C
eta/exclurad.F:3106:	   HNP=(EPH4+EPH1)/SQ2
eta/exclurad.F:3107:	   HNM=(EPH4-EPH1)/SQ2
eta/exclurad.F:3108:	   HFP=(EPH3-EPH2)/SQ2
eta/exclurad.F:3109:	   HFM=(EPH3+EPH2)/SQ2
eta/exclurad.F:3110:	   HN0=EPH5
eta/exclurad.F:3111:	   HF0=EPH6
eta/exclurad.F:3112:C
eta/exclurad.F:3113:C		Define the appreviations for the various polarized cross section terms
eta/exclurad.F:3114:C		Polarized beam, polarized target, polarized beam - polarized target
eta/exclurad.F:3115:C
eta/exclurad.F:3116:	   X1=HF0*CONJG(HNP) + HN0*CONJG(HFP)
eta/exclurad.F:3117:	   X2=HFM*CONJG(HNP) + HNM*CONJG(HFP)
eta/exclurad.F:3118:	   Y1=HNP*CONJG(HFP) + HNM*CONJG(HFM)
eta/exclurad.F:3119:	   Y2=HNM*CONJG(HFM) - HNP*CONJG(HFP)
eta/exclurad.F:3120:	   Y3=HN0*CONJG(HF0)
eta/exclurad.F:3121:	   Y4=HN0*CONJG(HFM) - HF0*CONJG(HNM)
eta/exclurad.F:3122:	   Z1=HN0*CONJG(HNP) - HF0*CONJG(HFP)
eta/exclurad.F:3123:	   Z2=HNM*CONJG(HNP) - HFM*CONJG(HFP)
eta/exclurad.F:3124:C
eta/exclurad.F:3125:C		These are the terms for the recoil polarizations
eta/exclurad.F:3126:C
eta/exclurad.F:3127:	   R1=CONJG(HN0)*HF0
eta/exclurad.F:3128:	   R2=CONJG(HNP)*HFP - CONJG(HNM)*HFM
eta/exclurad.F:3129:	   R3=CONJG(HN0)*HFM + CONJG(HF0)*HNP
eta/exclurad.F:3130:	   R4=CONJG(HF0)*HNM - CONJG(HN0)*HFM
eta/exclurad.F:3131:	   R5=CONJG(HN0)*HNP + CONJG(HF0)*HFP
eta/exclurad.F:3132:	   R6=CONJG(HNP)*HFP + CONJG(HNM)*HFM
eta/exclurad.F:3133:	   R7=CONJG(HFM)*HNP + CONJG(HFP)*HNM
eta/exclurad.F:3134:	   R8=CONJG(HFP)*HFM + CONJG(HNP)*HNM
eta/exclurad.F:3135:	   R9=CONJG(HNP)*HFM - CONJG(HNM)*HFP
eta/exclurad.F:3136:	   R10=CONJG(HNP)*HNM + CONJG(HFP)*HFM
eta/exclurad.F:3137:	   R11=CONJG(HN0)*HNM + CONJG(HF0)*HFM
eta/exclurad.F:3138:
eta/exclurad.F:3139:
eta/exclurad.F:3140:	   XILA=SQRT(2.*EPEPS*(EPEPS+1))
eta/exclurad.F:3141:	   SIGE=-POL_ELEC*SQRT(2*EPEPS*(1-EPEPS))*SIN(EPPHI*PI/180.)*
eta/exclurad.F:3142:     *	   AIMAG(HN0*CONJG(HNM)+HF0*CONJG(HFM))
eta/exclurad.F:3143:
eta/exclurad.F:3144:
eta/exclurad.F:3145:C	    SIGPT=PX*(-XILA*SIN(EPPHI*PI/180)*AIMAG(X1)-EPEPS*
eta/exclurad.F:3146:C     * 	SIN(EPPHI*PI/90.)*AIMAG(X2))
eta/exclurad.F:3147:C     *       -PY*(AIMAG(Y1)+EPEPS*COS(EPPHI*PI/90.)*AIMAG(Y2)
eta/exclurad.F:3148:C     * 	 +2.*EPEPS*AIMAG(Y3)+XILA*COS(EPPHI*PI/180)*AIMAG(Y4))
eta/exclurad.F:3149:C     * 	+PZ*(EPEPS*SIN(EPPHI*PI/90.)*AIMAG(Z2)+
eta/exclurad.F:3150:C     * 	     XILA*SIN(EPPHI*PI/180.)*AIMAG(Z1))
eta/exclurad.F:3151:C	SIGET=-POL_ELEC*(-PX*(SQRT(2.*EPEPS*(1-EPEPS))*COS(EPPHI*PI/180)
eta/exclurad.F:3152:C     * 	      *REAL(X1)+SQRT(1-EPEPS**2)*REAL(X2))
eta/exclurad.F:3153:C     *       +PY*SQRT(2.*EPEPS*(1-EPEPS))*SIN(EPPHI*PI/180.)*REAL(Y4)
eta/exclurad.F:3154:C     *       +PZ*(SQRT(1-EPEPS**2)*REAL(Z2)+SQRT(2*EPEPS*(1-EPEPS))*
eta/exclurad.F:3155:C     *        COS(EPPHI*PI/180.)*REAL(Z1)))
eta/exclurad.F:3156:C	    SIGMA = SIGMA + SIGE + SIGPT + SIGET
eta/exclurad.F:3157:C	    SIGMA=SIGMA*FKT
eta/exclurad.F:3158:ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
eta/exclurad.F:3159:C	  The target is polarized along the beam axis.
eta/exclurad.F:3160:c					PS = -1 anti-parallel to beam
eta/exclurad.F:3161:ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
eta/exclurad.F:3162:
eta/exclurad.F:3163:	   IF(EPQ2.LT.1.E-06.OR.EPEPS.LT.1.E-06)THEN
eta/exclurad.F:3164:		THETA_GAM = 0.
eta/exclurad.F:3165:	   ELSE
eta/exclurad.F:3166:	   ENUE = (EPW**2 - XMPROT**2 + EPQ2)/2./XMPROT
eta/exclurad.F:3167:	   THETA_ELEC = 2.*ATAN(SQRT(EPQ2/2./(EPQ2+ENUE**2)*
eta/exclurad.F:3168:     *			(1.-EPEPS)/EPEPS))
eta/exclurad.F:3169:	   E_ELEC_SCATT = -ENUE/2 + SQRT((ENUE/2.)**2 +
eta/exclurad.F:3170:     *			 EPQ2/4./SIN(THETA_ELEC/2.)**2)
eta/exclurad.F:3171:	   E_ELEC_PRIM = E_ELEC_SCATT + ENUE
eta/exclurad.F:3172:	   THETA_GAM = ATAN(SIN(THETA_ELEC)/
eta/exclurad.F:3173:     *		       (E_ELEC_PRIM/E_ELEC_SCATT - COS(THETA_ELEC)))
eta/exclurad.F:3174:	   THETA_GAM = THETA_GAM*180./PI
eta/exclurad.F:3175:	   ENDIF
eta/exclurad.F:3176:
eta/exclurad.F:3177:	   POL_X = POL_TARG*SINDD(THETA_GAM)*COSDD(EPPHI)
eta/exclurad.F:3178:	   POL_Y = POL_TARG*SINDD(THETA_GAM)*SINDD(EPPHI)
eta/exclurad.F:3179:	   POL_Z = POL_TARG*COSDD(THETA_GAM)
eta/exclurad.F:3180:
eta/exclurad.F:3181:	   SIGPT = - POL_X*(SINDD(EPPHI)*
eta/exclurad.F:3182:     1	SQRT(2.*EPEPS*(1. + EPEPS))*AIMAG(X1) +
eta/exclurad.F:3183:     2	EPEPS*SINDD(2.*EPPHI)*AIMAG(X2)) -
eta/exclurad.F:3184:     3	POL_Y*(AIMAG(Y1) +
eta/exclurad.F:3185:     4	EPEPS*COSDD(2.*EPPHI)*AIMAG(Y2) +
eta/exclurad.F:3186:     5	2.*EPEPS*AIMAG(Y3) +
eta/exclurad.F:3187:     6	SQRT(2.*EPEPS*(1.+EPEPS))*COSDD(EPPHI)*AIMAG(Y4)) +
eta/exclurad.F:3188:     7	POL_Z*(EPEPS*SINDD(2.*EPPHI)*AIMAG(Z2) +
eta/exclurad.F:3189:     8	SQRT(2.*EPEPS*(1. + EPEPS))*SINDD(EPPHI)*AIMAG(Z1))
eta/exclurad.F:3190:
eta/exclurad.F:3191:	SIGET = POL_ELEC*POL_TARG*(SINDD(THETA_GAM)*(COSDD(EPPHI))**2*
eta/exclurad.F:3192:     1	(REAL(Y4) + SQRT(2.*EPEPS*(1.-EPEPS))*REAL(X1))+
eta/exclurad.F:3193:     2	COSDD(EPPHI)*(SINDD(THETA_GAM)*SQRT(1.-EPEPS**2)*REAL(X2) -
eta/exclurad.F:3194:     3	COSDD(THETA_GAM)*SQRT(2.*EPEPS*(1.-EPEPS))*REAL(Z1)) -
eta/exclurad.F:3195:     4	SINDD(THETA_GAM)*REAL(Y4) - COSDD(THETA_GAM)*
eta/exclurad.F:3196:     5	SQRT(1.-EPEPS**2)*REAL(Z2))
eta/exclurad.F:3197:
eta/exclurad.F:3198:	   SIGMAO = SIGMAO + SIGE + SIGPT + SIGET
eta/exclurad.F:3199:
eta/exclurad.F:3200:c	    print *,SIGMAO , SIGE , SIGPT , SIGET
eta/exclurad.F:3201:
eta/exclurad.F:3202:
eta/exclurad.F:3203: 99	   SIGMAO = SIGMAO*FKT
eta/exclurad.F:3204:
eta/exclurad.F:3205:	   RETURN
eta/exclurad.F:3206:	   END

eta/exclurad.F:3295:****************** vacpol *************************************
eta/exclurad.F:3296:
eta/exclurad.F:3297:      double precision function vacpol(t)
eta/exclurad.F:3298:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:3299:      common/cmp/pi,alpha,amp,amp2,ap,ap2,aml2,amu2,amh2,barn
eta/exclurad.F:3300:      dimension am2(3)
eta/exclurad.F:3301:c
eta/exclurad.F:3302:c    am2 : squared masses of charge leptons
eta/exclurad.F:3303:c
eta/exclurad.F:3304:      data am2/.26110d-6,.111637d-1,3.18301d0/
eta/exclurad.F:3305:
eta/exclurad.F:3306:      suml=0.
eta/exclurad.F:3307:      do 10 i=1,3
eta/exclurad.F:3308:	 a2=2.*am2(i)
eta/exclurad.F:3309:	 sqlmi=dsqrt(t*t+2.*a2*t)
eta/exclurad.F:3310:	 allmi=dlog((sqlmi+t)/(sqlmi-t))/sqlmi
eta/exclurad.F:3311:  10  suml=suml+2.*(t+a2)*allmi/3.-10./9.+4.*a2*(1.-a2*allmi)/3./t
eta/exclurad.F:3312:      if(t.lt.1.d0)then
eta/exclurad.F:3313:	aaa = -1.345d-9
eta/exclurad.F:3314:	bbb = -2.302d-3
eta/exclurad.F:3315:	ccc = 4.091
eta/exclurad.F:3316:      elseif(t.lt.64d0)then
eta/exclurad.F:3317:	aaa = -1.512d-3
eta/exclurad.F:3318:	bbb =  -2.822d-3
eta/exclurad.F:3319:	ccc = 1.218
eta/exclurad.F:3320:      else
eta/exclurad.F:3321:	aaa = -1.1344d-3
eta/exclurad.F:3322:	bbb = -3.0680d-3
eta/exclurad.F:3323:	ccc = 9.9992d-1
eta/exclurad.F:3324:      endif
eta/exclurad.F:3325:      sumh = -(aaa+bbb*log(1.+ccc*t)) *2*pi/alpha
eta/exclurad.F:3326:
eta/exclurad.F:3327:      vacpol=suml+sumh
eta/exclurad.F:3328:
eta/exclurad.F:3329:      end

eta/exclurad.F:3331:****************** fspens *************************************
eta/exclurad.F:3332:
eta/exclurad.F:3333:      double precision function fspens(x)
eta/exclurad.F:3334:c
eta/exclurad.F:3335:c    spence function
eta/exclurad.F:3336:c
eta/exclurad.F:3337:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:3338:      f=0.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3339:      a=1.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3340:      an=0.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3341:      tch=1.d-16
eta/exclurad.F:3342:  1   an=an+1.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3343:      a=a*x
eta/exclurad.F:3344:      b=a/an**2
eta/exclurad.F:3345:      f=f+b
eta/exclurad.F:3346:      if(b-tch)2,2,1
eta/exclurad.F:3347:  2   fspens=f
eta/exclurad.F:3348:      return
eta/exclurad.F:3349:      end
eta/exclurad.F:3350:
eta/exclurad.F:3351:      double precision function fspen(x)
eta/exclurad.F:3352:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:3353:      data f1/1.644934d0/
eta/exclurad.F:3354:      if(x)8,1,1
eta/exclurad.F:3355:  1   if(x-.5d0)2,2,3
eta/exclurad.F:3356:    2 fspen=fspens(x)
eta/exclurad.F:3357:      return
eta/exclurad.F:3358:    3 if(x-1d0)4,4,5
eta/exclurad.F:3359:    4 fspen=f1-dlog(x)*dlog(1d0-x+1d-10)-fspens(1d0-x)
eta/exclurad.F:3360:      return
eta/exclurad.F:3361:    5 if(x-2d0)6,6,7
eta/exclurad.F:3362:    6 fspen=f1-.5*dlog(x)*dlog((x-1d0)**2/x)+fspens(1d0-1d0/x)
eta/exclurad.F:3363:      return
eta/exclurad.F:3364:    7 fspen=2d0*f1-.5d0*dlog(x)**2-fspens(1d0/x)
eta/exclurad.F:3365:      return
eta/exclurad.F:3366:    8 if(x+1d0)10,9,9
eta/exclurad.F:3367:   9  fspen=-.5d0*dlog(1d0-x)**2-fspens(x/(x-1d0))
eta/exclurad.F:3368:      return
eta/exclurad.F:3369:  10  fspen=-.5*dlog(1.-x)*dlog(x**2/(1d0-x))-f1+fspens(1d0/(1d0-x))
eta/exclurad.F:3370:      return
eta/exclurad.F:3371:      end

eta/exclurad.F:3589:      subroutine simps(a1,b1,h1,reps1,aeps1,funct,x,ai,aih,aiabs)
eta/exclurad.F:3590:c simps
eta/exclurad.F:3591:c a1,b1 -the limits of integration
eta/exclurad.F:3592:c h1 -an initial step of integration
eta/exclurad.F:3593:c reps1,aeps1 - relative and absolute precision of integration
eta/exclurad.F:3594:c funct -a name of function subprogram for calculation of integrand +
eta/exclurad.F:3595:c x - an argument of the integrand
eta/exclurad.F:3596:c ai - the value of integral
eta/exclurad.F:3597:c aih- the value of integral with the step of integration
eta/exclurad.F:3598:c aiabs- the value of integral for module of the integrand
eta/exclurad.F:3599:c this subrogram calculates the definite integral with the relative or
eta/exclurad.F:3600:c absolute precision by simpson+s method with the automatical choice
eta/exclurad.F:3601:c of the step of integration
eta/exclurad.F:3602:c if aeps1    is very small(like 1.e-17),then calculation of integral
eta/exclurad.F:3603:c with reps1,and if reps1 is very small (like 1.e-10),then calculation
eta/exclurad.F:3604:c of integral with aeps1
eta/exclurad.F:3605:c when aeps1=reps1=0. then calculation with the constant step h1
eta/exclurad.F:3606:c
eta/exclurad.F:3607:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:3608:      dimension f(7),p(5)
eta/exclurad.F:3609:      h=dsign(h1,b1-a1)
eta/exclurad.F:3610:      s=dsign(1.d0,h)
eta/exclurad.F:3611:      a=a1
eta/exclurad.F:3612:      b=b1
eta/exclurad.F:3613:      ai=0.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3614:      aih=0.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3615:      aiabs=0.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3616:      p(2)=4.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3617:      p(4)=4.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3618:      p(3)=2.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3619:      p(5)=1.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3620:      if(b-a) 1,2,1
eta/exclurad.F:3621:    1 reps=dabs(reps1)
eta/exclurad.F:3622:      aeps=dabs(aeps1)
eta/exclurad.F:3623:      do 3 k=1,7
eta/exclurad.F:3624:  3   f(k)=10.d16
eta/exclurad.F:3625:      x=a
eta/exclurad.F:3626:      c=0.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3627:      f(1)=funct(x)/3.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3628:    4 x0=x
eta/exclurad.F:3629:      if((x0+4.*h-b)*s) 5,5,6
eta/exclurad.F:3630:    6 h=(b-x0)/4.
eta/exclurad.F:3631:      if(h) 7,2,7
eta/exclurad.F:3632:    7 do 8 k=2,7
eta/exclurad.F:3633:  8   f(k)=10.d16
eta/exclurad.F:3634:      c=1.d0
eta/exclurad.F:3635:    5 di2=f(1)
eta/exclurad.F:3636:      di3=dabs(f(1))
eta/exclurad.F:3637:      do 9 k=2,5
eta/exclurad.F:3638:      x=x+h
eta/exclurad.F:3639:      if((x-b)*s) 23,24,24
eta/exclurad.F:3640:   24 x=b
eta/exclurad.F:3641:   23 if(f(k)-10.d16) 10,11,10
eta/exclurad.F:3642:   11 f(k)=funct(x)/3.
eta/exclurad.F:3643:   10 di2=di2+p(k)*f(k)
eta/exclurad.F:3644:    9 di3=di3+p(k)*abs(f(k))
eta/exclurad.F:3645:      di1=(f(1)+4.*f(3)+f(5))*2.*h
eta/exclurad.F:3646:      di2=di2*h
eta/exclurad.F:3647:      di3=di3*h
eta/exclurad.F:3648:      if(reps) 12,13,12
eta/exclurad.F:3649:   13 if(aeps) 12,14,12
eta/exclurad.F:3650:   12 eps=dabs((aiabs+di3)*reps)
eta/exclurad.F:3651:      if(eps-aeps) 15,16,16
eta/exclurad.F:3652:   15 eps=aeps
eta/exclurad.F:3653:   16 delta=dabs(di2-di1)
eta/exclurad.F:3654:      if(delta-eps) 20,21,21
eta/exclurad.F:3655:   20 if(delta-eps/8.) 17,14,14
eta/exclurad.F:3656:   17 h=2.*h
eta/exclurad.F:3657:      f(1)=f(5)
eta/exclurad.F:3658:      f(2)=f(6)
eta/exclurad.F:3659:      f(3)=f(7)

eta/exclurad.F:3856:	subroutine cgln_amps
eta/exclurad.F:3857:
eta/exclurad.F:3858:	implicit none
eta/exclurad.F:3859:
eta/exclurad.F:3860:	include 'mpintp.inc'
eta/exclurad.F:3861:	include 'spp.inc'
eta/exclurad.F:3862:
eta/exclurad.F:3863:	integer l

eta/exclurad.F:3865:	call multipole_amps
eta/exclurad.F:3866:
eta/exclurad.F:3867:	call legendre
eta/exclurad.F:3868:
eta/exclurad.F:3869:	if (method_helicity.eq.1) then
eta/exclurad.F:3870:
eta/exclurad.F:3871:	ff1 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3872:	ff2 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3873:	ff3 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3874:	ff4 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3875:	ff5 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3876:	ff6 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3877:
eta/exclurad.F:3878:	do l = 0, wave_L
eta/exclurad.F:3879:
eta/exclurad.F:3880:	  if(l.lt.2) then
eta/exclurad.F:3881:	     ff1 = ff1 + (    l*mp(l) +  ep(l))*pol(l+1,1)
eta/exclurad.F:3882:	  else
eta/exclurad.F:3883:	     ff1 = ff1 + (    l*mp(l) +  ep(l))*pol(l+1,1)
eta/exclurad.F:3884:     1		       + ((l+1)*mm(l) +  em(l))*pol(l-1,1)
eta/exclurad.F:3885:	  endif
eta/exclurad.F:3886:	enddo
eta/exclurad.F:3887:
eta/exclurad.F:3888:	do l = 1, wave_L
eta/exclurad.F:3889:	  ff2 = ff2 + ((l+1)*mp(l) + l*mm(l))*pol(l,1)
eta/exclurad.F:3890:	  if(l.lt.2) then
eta/exclurad.F:3891:	     ff3 = ff3 + (	ep(l) -   mp(l))*pol(l+1,2)
eta/exclurad.F:3892:	  else
eta/exclurad.F:3893:	     ff3 = ff3 + (	ep(l) -   mp(l))*pol(l+1,2) +
eta/exclurad.F:3894:     1			 (	em(l) +   mm(l))*pol(l-1,2)
eta/exclurad.F:3895:	  endif
eta/exclurad.F:3896:	enddo
eta/exclurad.F:3897:
eta/exclurad.F:3898:	do l = 2, wave_L
eta/exclurad.F:3899:	  ff4 = ff4 + (mp(l) - ep(l) -mm(l) - em(l))* pol(l,2)
eta/exclurad.F:3900:	enddo

eta/exclurad.F:3902:	do l = 0, wave_L

eta/exclurad.F:3905:	  else

eta/exclurad.F:3907:	  endif
eta/exclurad.F:3908:	enddo
eta/exclurad.F:3909:
eta/exclurad.F:3910:	do l = 1, wave_L

eta/exclurad.F:3938:      subroutine helicity_amps
eta/exclurad.F:3939:
eta/exclurad.F:3940:      implicit none
eta/exclurad.F:3941:
eta/exclurad.F:3942:      include 'mpintp.inc'
eta/exclurad.F:3943:      include 'spp.inc'
eta/exclurad.F:3944:
eta/exclurad.F:3945:      real   root2,s,s2,c,c2
eta/exclurad.F:3946:      real   theta_cm
eta/exclurad.F:3947:      integer l
eta/exclurad.F:3948:
eta/exclurad.F:3949:      data root2/1.41421/
eta/exclurad.F:3950:
eta/exclurad.F:3951:      call cgln_amps
eta/exclurad.F:3952:
eta/exclurad.F:3953:      theta_cm = acos(csthcm)
eta/exclurad.F:3954:
eta/exclurad.F:3955:      s   = sin(theta_cm)
eta/exclurad.F:3956:      c   = cos(theta_cm)
eta/exclurad.F:3957:      s2  = sin(theta_cm/2.0)
eta/exclurad.F:3958:      c2  = cos(theta_cm/2.0)
eta/exclurad.F:3959:
eta/exclurad.F:3960:      hh1 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3961:      hh2 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3962:      hh3 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3963:      hh4 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3964:      hh5 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3965:      hh6 = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:3966:
eta/exclurad.F:3967:      if(method_helicity.eq.1) then
eta/exclurad.F:3968:c	 hh1 = -s*(ff3 + ff4*c)/root2
eta/exclurad.F:3969:c	 hh2 = -(2*ff1 - 2*ff2*c + ff4*s2)/root2
eta/exclurad.F:3970:c	 hh3 = -ff4*s2/root2
eta/exclurad.F:3971:c	 hh4 = s*(2*ff2 + ff3 + ff4*c)/root2
eta/exclurad.F:3972:c	 hh5 = ff5 + ff6*c
eta/exclurad.F:3973:c	 hh6 = ff6*s
eta/exclurad.F:3974:	hh1 = -s*c2*(ff3 + ff4)/root2
eta/exclurad.F:3975:	hh2 =  c2*((ff2 - ff1) + 0.5*(1 - c)*(ff3 - ff4))*root2
eta/exclurad.F:3976:	hh3 =  s*s2*(ff3 - ff4)/root2
eta/exclurad.F:3977:	hh4 =  s2*((ff2 + ff1) + 0.5*(1 + c)*(ff3 + ff4))*root2
eta/exclurad.F:3978:	hh5 =  c2*(ff5 + ff6)
eta/exclurad.F:3979:	hh6 =  s2*(ff6 - ff5)
eta/exclurad.F:3980:
eta/exclurad.F:3981:      else
eta/exclurad.F:3982:
eta/exclurad.F:3983:	do l = 0, wave_L
eta/exclurad.F:3984:	  hh1 = hh1 + s*c2*(bp(l)-bm(l+1))*(pol(l,2)-pol(l+1,2))/root2
eta/exclurad.F:3985:	  hh2 = hh2 + c2*(ap(l)-am(l+1))*(pol(l,1)-pol(l+1,1))*root2
eta/exclurad.F:3986:	  hh3 = hh3 + s*s2*(bp(l)+bm(l+1))*(pol(l,2)+pol(l+1,2))/root2
eta/exclurad.F:3987:	  hh4 = hh4 + s2*(ap(l)+am(l+1))*(pol(l,1)+pol(l+1,1))*root2
eta/exclurad.F:3988:	  hh5 = hh5 - c2*(cp(l)-cm(l+1))*(pol(l,1)-pol(l+1,1))
eta/exclurad.F:3989:	  hh6 = hh6 - s2*(cp(l)+cm(l+1))*(pol(l,1)+pol(l+1,1))
eta/exclurad.F:3990:	enddo
eta/exclurad.F:3991:
eta/exclurad.F:3992:      endif
eta/exclurad.F:3993:
eta/exclurad.F:3994:      end

eta/exclurad.F:4197:
eta/exclurad.F:4198:      implicit none

eta/exclurad.F:4200:      include 'mpintp.inc'

eta/exclurad.F:4205:c

eta/exclurad.F:4207:c
eta/exclurad.F:4208:      pol(0,1) = 0.
eta/exclurad.F:4209:      pol(1,1) = 1.
eta/exclurad.F:4210:      pol(2,1) = 3.*X
eta/exclurad.F:4211:      pol(3,1) = (15.*X*X-3.)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:4212:      pol(4,1) = (35.*X*X*X-15.*X)/2.

eta/exclurad.F:4217:      pol(1,2) = 0.
eta/exclurad.F:4218:      pol(2,2) = 3.
eta/exclurad.F:4219:      pol(3,2) = 15.*X
eta/exclurad.F:4220:      pol(4,2) = (105.*X*X-15.)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:4221:      pol(5,2) = (315.*X*X*X-105.*X)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:4222:      pol(6,2) = (3465.*X*X*X*X-1890.*X*X+105.)/8.
eta/exclurad.F:4223:      pol(7,2) = (9009.*X*X*X*X*X-6930.*X*X*X +945.*X)/8.

eta/exclurad.F:4228:c      enddo
eta/exclurad.F:4229:      return

eta/exclurad.F:4360:	sm(2) = cmplx(vec_F(15),vec_F(16))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4361:	sm(3) = cmplx(vec_F(17),vec_F(18))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4362:	sm(4) = cmplx(vec_F(19),vec_F(20))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4363:	sm(5) = cmplx(vec_F(21),vec_F(22))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4364:
eta/exclurad.F:4365:	factor = 0.141383d0

eta/exclurad.F:4372:	ep(4) = cmplx(vec_F(31),vec_F(32))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4373:	ep(5) = cmplx(vec_F(33),vec_F(34))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4374:
eta/exclurad.F:4375:	    em(0) = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:4376:		em(1) = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:4377:	em(2) = cmplx(vec_F(35),vec_F(36))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4378:	em(3) = cmplx(vec_F(37),vec_F(38))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4379:	em(4) = cmplx(vec_F(39),vec_F(40))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4380:	em(5) = cmplx(vec_F(41),vec_F(42))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4381:
eta/exclurad.F:4382:		mp(0) = 0.0
eta/exclurad.F:4383:	mp(1) = cmplx(vec_F(43),vec_F(44))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4384:	mp(2) = cmplx(vec_F(45),vec_F(46))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4385:	mp(3) = cmplx(vec_F(47),vec_F(48))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4386:	mp(4) = cmplx(vec_F(49),vec_F(50))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4387:	mp(5) = cmplx(vec_F(51),vec_F(52))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4388:
eta/exclurad.F:4389:		mm(0) = 0.0

eta/exclurad.F:4391:	mm(2) = cmplx(vec_F(55),vec_F(56))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4392:	mm(3) = cmplx(vec_F(57),vec_F(58))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4393:	mm(4) = cmplx(vec_F(59),vec_F(60))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4394:	mm(5) = cmplx(vec_F(61),vec_F(62))*factor
eta/exclurad.F:4395:c
