eta/exclurad.F:4607:CEV The following two routines concern natural cubic spline interpolation
eta/exclurad.F:4608:C   of a function of two independent variables.
eta/exclurad.F:4609:C------------------------------------------------------------------------
eta/exclurad.F:4610:
eta/exclurad.F:4611:      SUBROUTINE splie2(x2a,ya,m,n,y2a)
eta/exclurad.F:4612:C
eta/exclurad.F:4613:C Given an m by n tabulated function ya(1:m,1:n), and tabulated independent
eta/exclurad.F:4614:C variable x2a(1:n), this routine constructs 1-dimensional natural cubic
eta/exclurad.F:4615:C splines of the 2nd dimension (1:n) of ya and returns the 2nd-derivatives in
eta/exclurad.F:4616:C the array y2a(1:m,1:n).  From "Numerical Recipes" (FORTRAN, 1992 Ed.),
eta/exclurad.F:4617:C Ch. 3.6, p. 121.  Call this routine only once, before a sequence of calls to
eta/exclurad.F:4618:C SPLIN2.  The process is of order  m x n.
eta/exclurad.F:4619:      IMPLICIT NONE
eta/exclurad.F:4620:C Passed variables:
eta/exclurad.F:4621:      INTEGER m,n
eta/exclurad.F:4622:      REAL x2a(n),ya(m,n),y2a(m,n)
eta/exclurad.F:4623:C Local variables:
eta/exclurad.F:4624:      INTEGER i,j,NN
eta/exclurad.F:4625:      REAL bound
eta/exclurad.F:4626:      PARAMETER (NN=100)     ! Maximum expected value of n
eta/exclurad.F:4627:      REAL ytmp(NN),y2tmp(NN)
eta/exclurad.F:4628:C Boundary condition threshold for natural cubic spline:
eta/exclurad.F:4629:      SAVE bound
eta/exclurad.F:4630:      DATA bound/1.e30/
eta/exclurad.F:4631:C
eta/exclurad.F:4632:      do i=1,m
eta/exclurad.F:4633:	 do j=1,n
eta/exclurad.F:4634:	    ytmp(j)=ya(i,j)
eta/exclurad.F:4635:	 enddo
eta/exclurad.F:4636:C Natural spline:
eta/exclurad.F:4637:	 call spline(x2a,ytmp,n,bound,bound,y2tmp)
eta/exclurad.F:4638:	 do j=1,n
eta/exclurad.F:4639:	    y2a(i,j)=y2tmp(j)
eta/exclurad.F:4640:	 enddo
eta/exclurad.F:4641:      enddo
eta/exclurad.F:4642:C
eta/exclurad.F:4643:      return
eta/exclurad.F:4644:      END
eta/exclurad.F:4645:C------------------------------------------------------------------------
eta/exclurad.F:4646:
eta/exclurad.F:4647:      SUBROUTINE splin2(x1a,x2a,ya,y2a,m,n,x1,x2,y)
eta/exclurad.F:4648:C
eta/exclurad.F:4649:C Given an m by n tabulated function ya(1:m,1:n), and tabulated independent
eta/exclurad.F:4650:C variables x1a(1:m), x2a(1:n), and tabulated 2nd-derivatives y2a(1:m,1:n) as
eta/exclurad.F:4651:C produced by SPLIE2; and given a desired interpolating point x1, x2; this
eta/exclurad.F:4652:C routine returns an interpolated function value y by 2-dimensional natural
eta/exclurad.F:4653:C cubic spline interpolation.  From "Numerical Recipes" (FORTRAN, 1992 Ed.),
eta/exclurad.F:4654:C Ch. 3.6, p. 121.  Call this routine sequentially after one call to SPLIE2.
eta/exclurad.F:4655:C The process is of order  m x logn + m + logm + 1 ; i.e., roughly, of order
eta/exclurad.F:4656:C m x logn.  Therefore, the optimum choice is n > m.
eta/exclurad.F:4657:      IMPLICIT NONE
eta/exclurad.F:4658:C Passed variables:
eta/exclurad.F:4659:      INTEGER m,n
eta/exclurad.F:4660:      REAL  x1a(m),x2a(n),ya(m,n),y2a(m,n),x1,x2,y
eta/exclurad.F:4661:C Local variables:
eta/exclurad.F:4662:      INTEGER i,j,NN
eta/exclurad.F:4663:      REAL bound
eta/exclurad.F:4664:      PARAMETER (NN=100)	   ! Maximum expected value of m, n
eta/exclurad.F:4665:      REAL ytmp(NN),yytmp(NN),y2tmp(NN)
eta/exclurad.F:4666:C Boundary condition threshold for natural cubic spline:
eta/exclurad.F:4667:      SAVE bound
eta/exclurad.F:4668:      DATA bound/1.e30/
eta/exclurad.F:4669:C
eta/exclurad.F:4670:      do i=1,m
eta/exclurad.F:4671:	 do j=1,n
eta/exclurad.F:4672:	    ytmp(j)=ya(i,j)
eta/exclurad.F:4673:	    y2tmp(j)=y2a(i,j)
eta/exclurad.F:4674:	 enddo
eta/exclurad.F:4675:C Perform n evaluations of the splines of the (1:n)-dimension constructed by
eta/exclurad.F:4676:C SPLIE2, using the 1-dimensional spline evaluator SPLINT.
eta/exclurad.F:4677:	 call splint(x2a,ytmp,y2tmp,n,x2,yytmp(i))
eta/exclurad.F:4678:      enddo
eta/exclurad.F:4679:C Construct the 1-dimensional natural spline of the (1:m)-dimension and
eta/exclurad.F:4680:C evaluate it.
eta/exclurad.F:4681:      call spline(x1a,yytmp,m,bound,bound,y2tmp)
eta/exclurad.F:4682:      call splint(x1a,yytmp,y2tmp,m,x1,y)
eta/exclurad.F:4683:C
eta/exclurad.F:4684:      return
eta/exclurad.F:4685:      END
eta/exclurad.F:4686:C------------------------------------------------------------------------
eta/exclurad.F:4687:CEV The subroutines SPLINE and SPLINT can be used for interpolating a
eta/exclurad.F:4688:C   function of one independent variable.
eta/exclurad.F:4689:C------------------------------------------------------------------------
eta/exclurad.F:4690:
eta/exclurad.F:4691:      SUBROUTINE spline(x,y,n,yp1,ypn,y2)
eta/exclurad.F:4692:C
eta/exclurad.F:4693:C Given arrays y(1:n) and x(1:n) containing a tabulated function and its
eta/exclurad.F:4694:C independent variable, respectively, with x(1) < x(2) < ... < x(n), and given
eta/exclurad.F:4695:C values yp1 and ypn for the 1st derivative of the interpolating function at
eta/exclurad.F:4696:C the points 1 and n, respectively, this routine returns an array y2(1:n) of
eta/exclurad.F:4697:C length n which contains the 2nd derivative of the interpolating function at
eta/exclurad.F:4698:C the tabulated points x(i).  If yp1 and/or ypn are equal to 10^30 or larger,
eta/exclurad.F:4699:C the routine is signaled to set the corresponding boundary condition for a
eta/exclurad.F:4700:C natural spline, with zero 2nd derivative on that boundary.  From "Numerical
eta/exclurad.F:4701:C Recipes", Ch. 3.3, p. 109.
eta/exclurad.F:4702:      IMPLICIT NONE
eta/exclurad.F:4703:C Passed variables:
eta/exclurad.F:4704:      INTEGER n
eta/exclurad.F:4705:      REAL x(n),y(n),yp1,ypn,y2(n)
eta/exclurad.F:4706:C Local variables:
eta/exclurad.F:4707:      INTEGER i,j,NMAX
eta/exclurad.F:4708:      PARAMETER (NMAX=500)	  ! Maximum expected value of n
eta/exclurad.F:4709:      REAL p,qn,sig,un,u(NMAX)
eta/exclurad.F:4710:C
eta/exclurad.F:4711:      if (yp1.gt..99e30) then
eta/exclurad.F:4712:C Natural lower boundary condition:
eta/exclurad.F:4713:	 y2(1)=0.e0
eta/exclurad.F:4714:	 u(1)=0.e0
eta/exclurad.F:4715:      else
eta/exclurad.F:4716:C Specified 1st derivative yp1:
eta/exclurad.F:4717:	 y2(1)=-.5e0
eta/exclurad.F:4718:	 u(1)=(3.e0/(x(2)-x(1)))*((y(2)-y(1))/(x(2)-x(1))-yp1)
eta/exclurad.F:4719:      endif
eta/exclurad.F:4720:C We need at least N+1 points to construct an interpolating polynomial
eta/exclurad.F:4721:C of degree N:
eta/exclurad.F:4722:      if (n.lt.4) stop ' Too few points for cubic spline'
eta/exclurad.F:4723:C
eta/exclurad.F:4724:C Decomposition loop of the tridiagonal algorithm.
eta/exclurad.F:4725:C y2,u: temporary storage of the decomposed factors.
eta/exclurad.F:4726:      do i=2,n-1
eta/exclurad.F:4727:	 sig=(x(i)-x(i-1))/(x(i+1)-x(i-1))
eta/exclurad.F:4728:	 p=sig*y2(i-1)+2.e0
eta/exclurad.F:4729:	 y2(i)=(sig-1.e0)/p
eta/exclurad.F:4730:	 u(i)=(6.e0*((y(i+1)-y(i))/(x(i+1)-x(i))-(y(i)-y(i-1))
eta/exclurad.F:4731:     &	      /(x(i)-x(i-1)))/(x(i+1)-x(i-1))-sig*u(i-1))/p
eta/exclurad.F:4732:      enddo
eta/exclurad.F:4733:      if (ypn.gt..99e30) then
eta/exclurad.F:4734:C Natural upper boundary condition:
eta/exclurad.F:4735:	 qn=0.e0
eta/exclurad.F:4736:	 un=0.e0
eta/exclurad.F:4737:      else
eta/exclurad.F:4738:C Specified 1st derivative ypn:
eta/exclurad.F:4739:	 qn=.5e0
eta/exclurad.F:4740:	 un=(3.e0/(x(n)-x(n-1)))*(ypn-(y(n)-y(n-1))/(x(n)-x(n-1)))
eta/exclurad.F:4741:      endif
eta/exclurad.F:4742:      y2(n)=(un-qn*u(n-1))/(qn*y2(n-1)+1.e0)
eta/exclurad.F:4743:C
eta/exclurad.F:4744:C Backsubstitution loop of the tridiagonal algorithm.
eta/exclurad.F:4745:      do j=n-1,1,-1
eta/exclurad.F:4746:	 y2(j)=y2(j)*y2(j+1)+u(j)
eta/exclurad.F:4747:      enddo
eta/exclurad.F:4748:C
eta/exclurad.F:4749:      return
eta/exclurad.F:4750:      END
eta/exclurad.F:4751:C------------------------------------------------------------------------
eta/exclurad.F:4752:
eta/exclurad.F:4753:      SUBROUTINE splint(xa,ya,y2a,n,x,y)
eta/exclurad.F:4754:C
eta/exclurad.F:4755:C Given the arrays ya(1:n) and xa(1:n) of length n, which tabulate a function
eta/exclurad.F:4756:C and its independent variable (with the xa(i) in order, as in SPLINE),
eta/exclurad.F:4757:C respectively, and given the array y2a(1:n), which is the output from SPLINE,
eta/exclurad.F:4758:C and given a value of x, this routine returns a cubic-spline interpolated
eta/exclurad.F:4759:C value y.  From "Numerical Recipes", Ch. 3.3, p. 110.
eta/exclurad.F:4760:      IMPLICIT NONE
eta/exclurad.F:4761:C Passed variables:
eta/exclurad.F:4762:      INTEGER n
eta/exclurad.F:4763:      REAL xa(n),ya(n),y2a(n),x,y
eta/exclurad.F:4764:C Local variables:
eta/exclurad.F:4765:      INTEGER k,klo,khi
eta/exclurad.F:4766:      REAL a,b,h
eta/exclurad.F:4767:C
eta/exclurad.F:4768:      klo=1
eta/exclurad.F:4769:      khi=n
eta/exclurad.F:4770:C
eta/exclurad.F:4771:C Locate the interpolation point by means of bisection.
eta/exclurad.F:4772:C This is optimal if sequential calls to this routine are at random values
eta/exclurad.F:4773:C of x. If sequential calls are in order, and closely spaced, it would be
eta/exclurad.F:4774:C better to store previous values of klo and khi and test if they remain
eta/exclurad.F:4775:C appropriate on the next call.
eta/exclurad.F:4776: 1    if (khi-klo.gt.1) then
eta/exclurad.F:4777:	 k=(khi+klo)/2
eta/exclurad.F:4778:	 if (xa(k).gt.x) then
eta/exclurad.F:4779:	    khi=k
eta/exclurad.F:4780:	 else
eta/exclurad.F:4781:	    klo=k
eta/exclurad.F:4782:	 endif
eta/exclurad.F:4783:	 go to 1
eta/exclurad.F:4784:      endif
eta/exclurad.F:4785:C klo,khi now bracket x.
eta/exclurad.F:4786:      h=xa(khi)-xa(klo)
eta/exclurad.F:4787:C The xa's must be distinct:
eta/exclurad.F:4788:      if (h.eq.0.e0) stop ' Bad xa input in splint'
eta/exclurad.F:4789:C Evaluate now the cubic spline polynomial:
eta/exclurad.F:4790:      a=(xa(khi)-x)/h
eta/exclurad.F:4791:      b=(x-xa(klo))/h
eta/exclurad.F:4792:      y=a*ya(klo)+b*ya(khi)+
eta/exclurad.F:4793:     &	((a*a*a-a)*y2a(klo)+(b*b*b-b)*y2a(khi))*(h*h)/6.e0
eta/exclurad.F:4794:C
eta/exclurad.F:4795:      return
eta/exclurad.F:4796:      END
eta/exclurad.F:4797:      subroutine xsection
eta/exclurad.F:4798:
eta/exclurad.F:4799:      implicit none
eta/exclurad.F:4800:
eta/exclurad.F:4801:      include 'mpintp.inc'
eta/exclurad.F:4802:      include 'spp.inc'
eta/exclurad.F:4803:
eta/exclurad.F:4804:      real vl, vt, vlt, vtt, vltp
eta/exclurad.F:4805:      real phicm_rad, ekin
eta/exclurad.F:4806:      real sig_l,sig_t,sig_lt,sig_tt,sig_ltp
eta/exclurad.F:4807:
eta/exclurad.F:4808:      call multipole_amps ! calc. multipole amplitudes
eta/exclurad.F:4809:      call helicity_amps  ! calc. helicity amplitudes
eta/exclurad.F:4810:
eta/exclurad.F:4811:      phicm_rad = phicm*pi/180.0
eta/exclurad.F:4812:
eta/exclurad.F:4813:      vt   = 1.0
eta/exclurad.F:4814:      vl   = epsilon
eta/exclurad.F:4815:      vtt  = epsilon
eta/exclurad.F:4816:      vlt  = sqrt(epsilon*(1+epsilon)/2)
eta/exclurad.F:4817:      vltp = sqrt(epsilon*(1-epsilon)/2)
eta/exclurad.F:4818:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
eta/exclurad.F:4819:c     this is relevant chagne due to nu_cm
eta/exclurad.F:4820:c      ekin = Q2/nu_cm**2
eta/exclurad.F:4821:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
eta/exclurad.F:4822:      ekin = sqrt(Q2) / nu_cm
eta/exclurad.F:4823:ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
eta/exclurad.F:4824:      fkt  = 2*W*ppi_mag_cm/(W**2 - m_p**2)
eta/exclurad.F:4825:
eta/exclurad.F:4826:      sigma_t  = (cabs(hh1)**2+cabs(hh2)**2
eta/exclurad.F:4827:     1		 +cabs(hh3)**2+cabs(hh4)**2)/2.
eta/exclurad.F:4828:      sigma_l  =  cabs(hh5)**2+cabs(hh6)**2
eta/exclurad.F:4829:      sigma_tt =  real(-conjg(hh1)*hh4+conjg(hh2)*hh3)
eta/exclurad.F:4830:      sigma_lt =  real(conjg(hh5)*(hh1-hh4)  +
eta/exclurad.F:4831:     1			conjg(hh6)*(hh2+hh3))*sqrt(2.0)
eta/exclurad.F:4832:      sigma_ltp = -aimag(conjg(hh5)*(hh1-hh4) +
eta/exclurad.F:4833:     1			conjg(hh6)*(hh2+hh3))*sqrt(2.0)
eta/exclurad.F:4834:
eta/exclurad.F:4835:      sigma_l  = sigma_l*ekin**2
eta/exclurad.F:4836:      sigma_t  = sigma_t
eta/exclurad.F:4837:      sigma_tt = sigma_tt
eta/exclurad.F:4838:      sigma_lt = sigma_lt*ekin
eta/exclurad.F:4839:      sigma_ltp= sigma_ltp*ekin
eta/exclurad.F:4840:
eta/exclurad.F:4841:      sigma_0  = fkt*( vt*sigma_t   + vl*sigma_l +
eta/exclurad.F:4842:     1		 vtt*sigma_tt*cos(2*phicm_rad) +
eta/exclurad.F:4843:     1		 vlt*sigma_lt*cos(  phicm_rad) ) +
eta/exclurad.F:4844:     1	     e_hel*vltp*sigma_ltp*sin(phicm_rad)
eta/exclurad.F:4845:
eta/exclurad.F:4846:c      print *, 'XSECTION',sigma_0,sigma_t,sigma_l,sigma_tt,sigma_lt
eta/exclurad.F:4847:
eta/exclurad.F:4848:      sigma_0_5fold = gamma_v*sigma_0
eta/exclurad.F:4849:
eta/exclurad.F:4850:      end
eta/exclurad.F:4851:
eta/exclurad.F:4852:
eta/exclurad.F:4853:      subroutine d01fce(ndim, a, b, minpts, maxpts, functn, eps,
eta/exclurad.F:4854:     * acc, lenwrk, wrkstr, finval, ifail)
eta/exclurad.F:4855:      implicit real*8(a-h,o-z)
eta/exclurad.F:4856:c     mark 8 release. nag copyright 1979.
eta/exclurad.F:4857:c
eta/exclurad.F:4858:c     adaptive multidimensional integration subroutine
eta/exclurad.F:4859:c
eta/exclurad.F:4860:c     *********  parameters for d01fce ****************************
eta/exclurad.F:4861:c
eta/exclurad.F:4862:c      input parameters
eta/exclurad.F:4863:c
eta/exclurad.F:4864:c     ndim    integer number of variables, must exceed 1 but
eta/exclurad.F:4865:c	  not exceed 15.
eta/exclurad.F:4866:c
eta/exclurad.F:4867:c     a       real array of lower limits, with dimension ndim
eta/exclurad.F:4868:c
eta/exclurad.F:4869:c     b       real array of upper limits, with dimension ndim
eta/exclurad.F:4870:c
eta/exclurad.F:4871:c     minpts  integer minimum number of integrand values to be
eta/exclurad.F:4872:c	  allowed, which must not exceed maxpts.
eta/exclurad.F:4873:c
eta/exclurad.F:4874:c     maxpts  integer maximum number of integrand values to be
eta/exclurad.F:4875:c	  allowed, which must be at least
eta/exclurad.F:4876:c	  2**ndim+2*ndim**2+2*ndim+1.
eta/exclurad.F:4877:c
eta/exclurad.F:4878:c     functn  externally declared user defined real function
eta/exclurad.F:4879:c	  integrand. it must have parameters (ndim,z),
eta/exclurad.F:4880:c	  where z is a real array of dimension ndim.
eta/exclurad.F:4881:c
eta/exclurad.F:4882:c     eps     real required relative accuracy, must be greater
eta/exclurad.F:4883:c	  than zero
eta/exclurad.F:4884:c
eta/exclurad.F:4885:c     lenwrk  integer length of array wrkstr, must be at least
eta/exclurad.F:4886:c	  2*ndim+4.
eta/exclurad.F:4887:c
eta/exclurad.F:4888:c     ifail   integer nag failure parameter
eta/exclurad.F:4889:c	  ifail=0 for hard fail
eta/exclurad.F:4890:c	  ifail=1 for soft fail
eta/exclurad.F:4891:c
eta/exclurad.F:4892:c      output parameters
eta/exclurad.F:4893:c
eta/exclurad.F:4894:c     minpts  integer number of integrand values used by the
eta/exclurad.F:4895:c	  routine
eta/exclurad.F:4896:c
eta/exclurad.F:4897:c     wrkstr  real array of working storage of dimension (lenwrk).
eta/exclurad.F:4898:c
eta/exclurad.F:4899:c     acc     real estimated relative accuracy of finval
eta/exclurad.F:4900:c
eta/exclurad.F:4901:c     finval  real estimated value of integral
eta/exclurad.F:4902:c
eta/exclurad.F:4903:c     ifail   ifail=0 for normal exit, when estimated relative
eta/exclurad.F:4904:c	    less integaccuracy rand values used.
eta/exclurad.F:4905:c
eta/exclurad.F:4906:c      ifail=1 if ndim.lt.2, ndim.gt.15, minpts.gt.maxpts,
eta/exclurad.F:4907:c	    maxpts.lt.2**ndim+2*ndim*(ndim+1)+1, eps.le.0
eta/exclurad.F:4908:c	    or lenwrk.lt.2*ndim+4.
eta/exclurad.F:4909:c
eta/exclurad.F:4910:c      ifail=2 if maxpts was too small for d01fce to obtain the
eta/exclurad.F:4911:c	    required relative accuracy eps.  in this
eta/exclurad.F:4912:c	    case d01fce returns a value of finval
eta/exclurad.F:4913:c	    with estimated relative accuracy acc.
eta/exclurad.F:4914:c
eta/exclurad.F:4915:c      ifail=3 if lenwrk too small for maxpts integrand
eta/exclurad.F:4916:c	    values.  in this case d01fce returns a
eta/exclurad.F:4917:c	    value of finval with estimated accuracy
eta/exclurad.F:4918:c	    acc using the working storage
eta/exclurad.F:4919:c	    available, but acc will be greater
eta/exclurad.F:4920:c	    than eps.
eta/exclurad.F:4921:c
eta/exclurad.F:4922:c     **************************************************************
eta/exclurad.F:4923:c
eta/exclurad.F:4924:c     .. scalar arguments ..
eta/exclurad.F:4925:*     real eps, finval, acc
eta/exclurad.F:4926:*     integer ifail, lenwrk, maxpts, minpts, ndim
eta/exclurad.F:4927:c     .. array arguments ..
eta/exclurad.F:4928:**    real a(ndim), b(ndim), wrkstr(lenwrk)
eta/exclurad.F:4929:      dimension a(ndim), b(ndim), wrkstr(lenwrk)
eta/exclurad.F:4930:c     .. function arguments ..
eta/exclurad.F:4931:*     real functn
eta/exclurad.F:4932:c     ..
eta/exclurad.F:4933:c     .. local scalars ..
eta/exclurad.F:4934:      character*8 srname
eta/exclurad.F:4935:      double precision
eta/exclurad.F:4936:     * abserr, df1, df2, difmax, f1, f2, f3, f4, half, lamda2,
eta/exclurad.F:4937:     * lamda4, lamda5, one, ratio, rgncmp, rgnerr, rgnert, rgnval,
eta/exclurad.F:4938:     * rgnvlt, rgnvol, rlndim, sum1, sum2, sum3, sum4, sum5, two,
eta/exclurad.F:4939:     * twondm, weit1, weit2, weit3, weit4, weit5, weitp1, weitp2,
eta/exclurad.F:4940:     * weitp3, weitp4, zero
eta/exclurad.F:4941:      integer dvaxes, dvaxis, dvflag, funcls, ierror, j, k, maxaxs,
eta/exclurad.F:4942:     * mxrgns, pointr, rgncls, rulcls, sbrgns, subrgn, subtmp,
eta/exclurad.F:4943:     * tpontp, tpontr
eta/exclurad.F:4944:c     .. local arrays ..
eta/exclurad.F:4945:      dimension center(15), dif(15), oldcnt(15), width(15), z(15)
eta/exclurad.F:4946:      integer dvcntl(15), dvcntr(15)
eta/exclurad.F:4947:c     .. function references ..
eta/exclurad.F:4948:*     real sqrt, x02aae
eta/exclurad.F:4949:      integer p01aae, x02bbe
eta/exclurad.F:4950:c     ..
eta/exclurad.F:4951:      data srname /'  d01fce'/
eta/exclurad.F:4952:      data zero, one, two, half /0.d0, 1.d0, 2.d0, 0.5d0/
eta/exclurad.F:4953:c
eta/exclurad.F:4954:c   subroutine initialisation and parameter checking
eta/exclurad.F:4955:c
eta/exclurad.F:4956:      if (ndim.lt.2 .or. ndim.gt.15) go to 560
eta/exclurad.F:4957:      if (minpts.gt.maxpts) go to 560
eta/exclurad.F:4958:      if (eps.le.zero) go to 560
eta/exclurad.F:4959:      if (lenwrk.lt.2*ndim+4) go to 560
eta/exclurad.F:4960:      funcls = 0
eta/exclurad.F:4961:      finval = zero
eta/exclurad.F:4962:      abserr = zero
eta/exclurad.F:4963:      twondm = two**ndim
eta/exclurad.F:4964:      rgnvol = twondm
eta/exclurad.F:4965:      dvflag = 1
eta/exclurad.F:4966:      fffff1 = float(x02bbe(one))
eta/exclurad.F:4967:      fffff2 = 1.0/x02aae(0.0d0)
eta/exclurad.F:4968:      maxaxs = int(dmin1(fffff1,fffff2))
eta/exclurad.F:4969:c     maxaxs = int(amin1(float(x02bbe(one)),1.0/x02aae(0.0d0)))
eta/exclurad.F:4970:      maxaxs = (maxaxs-ndim)/(ndim+1)
eta/exclurad.F:4971:      mxrgns = lenwrk/(2*ndim+4)
eta/exclurad.F:4972:      sbrgns = 0
eta/exclurad.F:4973:      rgnvlt = zero
eta/exclurad.F:4974:      rgnert = zero
eta/exclurad.F:4975:      do 20 j=1,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:4976:       center(j) = (a(j)+b(j))*half
eta/exclurad.F:4977:       dif(j) = zero
eta/exclurad.F:4978:       width(j) = (b(j)-a(j))*half
eta/exclurad.F:4979:       dvcntl(j) = 1
eta/exclurad.F:4980:       dvcntr(j) = 1
eta/exclurad.F:4981:       oldcnt(j) = center(j)
eta/exclurad.F:4982:       rgnvol = rgnvol*width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:4983:   20 continue
eta/exclurad.F:4984:c
eta/exclurad.F:4985:c   end subroutine initialisation
eta/exclurad.F:4986:c   basic rule initialisation
eta/exclurad.F:4987:c
eta/exclurad.F:4988:      rulcls = 2**ndim + 2*ndim*ndim + 2*ndim + 1
eta/exclurad.F:4989:      funcls = rulcls
eta/exclurad.F:4990:      if (maxpts.lt.rulcls) go to 560
eta/exclurad.F:4991:      rlndim = ndim
eta/exclurad.F:4992:      lamda2 = sqrt(9.0/70.0)
eta/exclurad.F:4993:      lamda4 = sqrt(9.0/10.0)
eta/exclurad.F:4994:      lamda5 = sqrt(9.0/19.0)
eta/exclurad.F:4995:      weit1 = (12824.0-9120.0*rlndim+400.0*rlndim*rlndim)/19683.0
eta/exclurad.F:4996:      weit2 = 980.0/6561.0
eta/exclurad.F:4997:      weit3 = (1820.0-400.0*rlndim)/19683.0
eta/exclurad.F:4998:      weit4 = 200.0/19683.0
eta/exclurad.F:4999:      weit5 = 6859.0/19683.0/twondm
eta/exclurad.F:5000:      weitp1 = (729.0-950.0*rlndim+50.0*rlndim**2)/729.0
eta/exclurad.F:5001:      weitp2 = 245.0/486.0
eta/exclurad.F:5002:      weitp3 = (265.0-100.0*rlndim)/1458.0
eta/exclurad.F:5003:      weitp4 = 25.0/729.0
eta/exclurad.F:5004:      ratio = (lamda2/lamda4)**2
eta/exclurad.F:5005:c
eta/exclurad.F:5006:c   end basic rule initialisation
eta/exclurad.F:5007:      go to 100
eta/exclurad.F:5008:c   divide subregion with largest error and prepare to use
eta/exclurad.F:5009:c   basic rule on each portion
eta/exclurad.F:5010:c
eta/exclurad.F:5011:   40 subrgn = 1
eta/exclurad.F:5012:      pointr = wrkstr(1)
eta/exclurad.F:5013:      rgncls = rulcls
eta/exclurad.F:5014:      rgnvol = twondm
eta/exclurad.F:5015:      tpontr = pointr + 2
eta/exclurad.F:5016:      do 60 j=1,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5017:       tpontr = tpontr + 2
eta/exclurad.F:5018:       center(j) = wrkstr(tpontr-1)
eta/exclurad.F:5019:       width(j) = wrkstr(tpontr)
eta/exclurad.F:5020:       dvcntr(j) = 1
eta/exclurad.F:5021:       dvcntl(j) = 1
eta/exclurad.F:5022:       oldcnt(j) = center(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5023:       rgnvol = rgnvol*width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5024:   60 continue
eta/exclurad.F:5025:      dvaxes = wrkstr(pointr+2)
eta/exclurad.F:5026:      if (dvaxes.lt.0) go to 600
eta/exclurad.F:5027:   80 dvaxis = dvaxes
eta/exclurad.F:5028:      dvaxes = dvaxis/(ndim+1)
eta/exclurad.F:5029:      dvaxis = dvaxis - (ndim+1)*dvaxes
eta/exclurad.F:5030:      dvcntl(dvaxis) = 2*dvcntl(dvaxis)
eta/exclurad.F:5031:      rgncls = rgncls*2
eta/exclurad.F:5032:      if (dvaxes.gt.0) go to 80
eta/exclurad.F:5033:      if (funcls+rgncls.gt.maxpts) go to 580
eta/exclurad.F:5034:      if (rgncls/rulcls+sbrgns-1.gt.mxrgns) dvflag = 2
eta/exclurad.F:5035:      funcls = funcls + rgncls
eta/exclurad.F:5036:c      print *,funcls
eta/exclurad.F:5037:      abserr = abserr - wrkstr(pointr)
eta/exclurad.F:5038:      finval = finval - wrkstr(pointr+1)
eta/exclurad.F:5039:c
eta/exclurad.F:5040:c   begin basic rule
eta/exclurad.F:5041:  100 do 120 j=1,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5042:       z(j) = center(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5043:  120 continue
eta/exclurad.F:5044:      sum1 = functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5045:      sum2 = zero
eta/exclurad.F:5046:      sum3 = zero
eta/exclurad.F:5047:      do 140 j=1,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5048:       z(j) = center(j) - lamda2*width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5049:       f1 = functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5050:       z(j) = center(j) + lamda2*width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5051:       f2 = functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5052:       z(j) = center(j) - lamda4*width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5053:       f3 = functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5054:       z(j) = center(j) + lamda4*width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5055:       f4 = functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5056:       sum2 = sum2 + f1 + f2
eta/exclurad.F:5057:       sum3 = sum3 + f3 + f4
eta/exclurad.F:5058:       df1 = f1 + f2 - two*sum1
eta/exclurad.F:5059:       df2 = f3 + f4 - two*sum1
eta/exclurad.F:5060:       dif(j) = dif(j) + abs(df1-ratio*df2)
eta/exclurad.F:5061:       z(j) = center(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5062:  140 continue
eta/exclurad.F:5063:      sum4 = zero
eta/exclurad.F:5064:      do 200 j=2,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5065:       z(j-1) = center(j-1) - lamda4*width(j-1)
eta/exclurad.F:5066:       do 160 k=j,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5067:	  z(k) = center(k) - lamda4*width(k)
eta/exclurad.F:5068:	  sum4 = sum4 + functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5069:	  z(k) = center(k) + lamda4*width(k)
eta/exclurad.F:5070:	  sum4 = sum4 + functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5071:	  z(k) = center(k)
eta/exclurad.F:5072:  160  continue
eta/exclurad.F:5073:       z(j-1) = center(j-1) + lamda4*width(j-1)
eta/exclurad.F:5074:       do 180 k=j,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5075:	  z(k) = center(k) - lamda4*width(k)
eta/exclurad.F:5076:	  sum4 = sum4 + functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5077:	  z(k) = center(k) + lamda4*width(k)
eta/exclurad.F:5078:	  sum4 = sum4 + functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5079:	  z(k) = center(k)
eta/exclurad.F:5080:  180  continue
eta/exclurad.F:5081:       z(j-1) = center(j-1)
eta/exclurad.F:5082:  200 continue
eta/exclurad.F:5083:      sum5 = zero
eta/exclurad.F:5084:      do 220 j=1,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5085:       z(j) = center(j) - lamda5*width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5086:  220 continue
eta/exclurad.F:5087:  240 do 260 j=2,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5088:       if (z(j-1).lt.center(j-1)+width(j-1)) go to 280
eta/exclurad.F:5089:       z(j-1) = center(j-1) - lamda5*width(j-1)
eta/exclurad.F:5090:       z(j) = z(j) + two*lamda5*width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5091:  260 continue
eta/exclurad.F:5092:      if (z(ndim).gt.center(ndim)+width(ndim)) go to 300
eta/exclurad.F:5093:  280 sum5 = sum5 + functn(ndim,z)
eta/exclurad.F:5094:      z(1) = z(1) + two*lamda5*width(1)
eta/exclurad.F:5095:      go to 240
eta/exclurad.F:5096:  300 rgnval = rgnvol*(weit1*sum1+weit2*sum2+weit3*sum3+weit4*
eta/exclurad.F:5097:     * sum4+weit5*sum5)
eta/exclurad.F:5098:      rgncmp = rgnvol*(weitp1*sum1+weitp2*sum2+weitp3*sum3+weitp4*
eta/exclurad.F:5099:     * sum4)
eta/exclurad.F:5100:      rgnerr = abs(rgnval-rgncmp)
eta/exclurad.F:5101:c
eta/exclurad.F:5102:c   end basic rule
eta/exclurad.F:5103:c   store results of basic rule application
eta/exclurad.F:5104:c
eta/exclurad.F:5105:      rgnvlt = rgnvlt + rgnval
eta/exclurad.F:5106:      rgnert = rgnert + rgnerr
eta/exclurad.F:5107:      finval = finval + rgnval
eta/exclurad.F:5108:      abserr = abserr + rgnerr
eta/exclurad.F:5109:      if (dvflag.eq.0) go to 340
eta/exclurad.F:5110:      if (dvflag.eq.2) go to 500
eta/exclurad.F:5111:      pointr = mxrgns + sbrgns*(2*ndim+3) + 1
eta/exclurad.F:5112:      sbrgns = sbrgns + 1
eta/exclurad.F:5113:      wrkstr(sbrgns) = pointr
eta/exclurad.F:5114:      subrgn = sbrgns
eta/exclurad.F:5115:      tpontr = pointr + 2
eta/exclurad.F:5116:      do 320 j=1,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5117:       tpontr = tpontr + 2
eta/exclurad.F:5118:       wrkstr(tpontr-1) = center(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5119:       wrkstr(tpontr) = width(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5120:  320 continue
eta/exclurad.F:5121:  340 wrkstr(pointr) = rgnert
eta/exclurad.F:5122:      wrkstr(pointr+1) = rgnvlt
eta/exclurad.F:5123:c   determine axis along which fourth difference is largest
eta/exclurad.F:5124:      difmax = zero
eta/exclurad.F:5125:      do 380 j=1,ndim
eta/exclurad.F:5126:       if (difmax.gt.dif(j)) go to 360
eta/exclurad.F:5127:       difmax = dif(j)
eta/exclurad.F:5128:       dvaxis = j
eta/exclurad.F:5129:  360	    dif(j) = zero
eta/exclurad.F:5130:  380 continue
eta/exclurad.F:5131:      tpontr = pointr + 2*(dvaxis+1)
eta/exclurad.F:5132:      wrkstr(tpontr) = width(dvaxis)*half
eta/exclurad.F:5133:      wrkstr(tpontr-1) = center(dvaxis) - wrkstr(tpontr)
eta/exclurad.F:5134:      if (dvflag.ne.2) go to 400
eta/exclurad.F:5135:      dvaxes = wrkstr(pointr+2)
eta/exclurad.F:5136:      if (dvaxes.gt.maxaxs) dvaxes = -1
eta/exclurad.F:5137:      dvaxis = dvaxis + (ndim+1)*dvaxes
